A defenseman leaves from the centre ice near the wall, skates across the ice down towards the opposite side neutral zone face off dot and pivots to backward. At this point, forward (with timing)leaves the hash mark with puck, skates towards blue line and passes it to the defenseman while skating backwards. That forward continues to skate up the boards, going outside the blue line, does a tight turn towards the face off dot (to the middle), and retrieves the touch-pass back from the defenseman, using the face off dot as a guide, then shoots. Defenseman alternates sides and repeats pattern 4 times. After 4th rep, next defenseman jumps in to continue drill. Key Points: "D" Clean Pivots and touch pass to an area ( use dots as a guide ) "F" tight turns outside the blue line "F" , stay outside the dots (close to the boards) when entering the zone

items.title: 2vs0 with a route, give and go attack, drive wide trailer pass - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2vs0 with a route, give and go attack, drive wide trailer pass - 10 mins
items.description: t e b ue e , stay outs de t e dots (c ose to t e boa ds) e e te g t e o e On the whistle, players head across the the ice around a pylon and back toward the line that they came from. Receive a pass from the line and head up ice using the dots as a guide. Pass the puck through the neutral zone to a player who is just outside the attacking blue line. Accelerate to get the puck back on a give and go then carry the puck over the blue line and drive wide (not going over the goal line) With good gap space and timing the player who gave the give and go pass swings up over the neutral zone face off dot, heading down the middle and attacks as the trailer with their stick on the ice ready to receive the trailer pass and take a quick release shot with both players heading to the net! Key Points: Timing when in the trailer position...(DELAY) so the pass is made towards the blue line

items.title: 3vs0 with breakout simulation, triangular zone entry - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3vs0 with breakout simulation, triangular zone entry - 10 mins
items.description: Whistle generated. Both ends go at the same time. The dot line player goes in to retrieve a puck and passes to the player who was on the same side wall that came down to post up at the low hash mark against the boards. The far side line player, comes under deep as the support and takes the pass from the posted up player (breakout simulation). The player carries the puck all the way down to the other end, driving wide and deep(as the triple threat). The posted up player heads directly to far post (net presence). The retrieval player acts as the trailer staying up high. (forming the triangular attack) The puck carrier has 3 options 1.shoot 2. pass to the net or 3. pass to the trailer. Key Points: Drive wide on entry Triple threat options(Triangular formation) 1 Shoot 2 Pass to post (net) 3 Pass to trailer One pass maximum then shoot! Then swarm the net (game like) NO ONE GOES OVER THE GOAL LINE!! EVERYONE TO THE BLUE PAINT!

items.title: 3vs0 transition with a primary post up - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3vs0 transition with a primary post up - 10 mins
items.description: 3 players leave line on the whistle. 1st one with a puck heads diagonally across the ice towards the other line. Make a long hard pass to player in front of the other side line and swings wide, away and towards the far side boards. 2nd player follows right behind the 1st, gets the pass back and touch passes the puck back to the line and swings into the middle(tighter turn heading up ice).The 3rd player swing pivots facing the puck and does the post up just above the center red line. The primary pass is to the post up, straight up the boards... But the stationary player can pass to anyone heading up the ice. The 3 players in the drill can now enter the zone with a triangular attack using the triple threat options. The sides alternate. (one then the other) Frequency is based on the players speed. Key Points: Full(game)speed Sticks on the ice Spread out! Hard passes. Set up triangular attack on entry Swarm the blue paint (crease) after the shot Never cross over the goal line in this drill

items.title: Continuous shooting bump passes (evaluation) - 10 mins
items.description: g,p g g p p p 1st player leaves with a puck and shoots at about the hash marks. Follow your shot to the net for a possible rebound. Stop in front of the net for a split second (on the rebound search) then head straight back to the line with your stick on the ice ready to receive a pass from the next player. The next player makes that pass with their feet moving they get a one touch (bump back) pass and continue the drill. Key Points: Straight to the net after the shot. stick on the ice with 2 hands on the stick! Both ends and switch sides after 4, 5 minutes

items.title: Continuous swing with a bump pass (evaluation) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous swing with a bump pass (evaluation) - 10 mins
items.description: s tc s des a te , 5 utes One side starts... go in on an angle take a quick release shot! (check for a feasible rebound) Then head over to the other side with your stick on the ice ready to do a puck exchange (bump Pass) for the other play to continue the drill. Its continuous going from side to side in both ends. Key Points: Stick on the ice Feet moving when passing check for rebounds

items.title: Warm up transition simulation (continuous) - 10 mins
items.description: ey o ts St c o t e ce eet o g e pass g c ec o ebou ds One side starts... player starts without a puck goes around the center face off circle... Player from the other side pass with their feet moving and keeps the drill going (continuous) Key Points: Pass with feet moving Can open up to the puck if required

items.title: Full ice warm up end to end (down and back) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Full ice warm up end to end (down and back) - 10 mins
items.description: One side starts... head across the ice through the slot receive a pass from the other side using the face off dots as a guide to receiving the pass (stick on the ice@ 2 hands on the stick!) Skate through the neutral zone with the puck on the forehand side of your body (puck in a prepared position) ready to be released at any time! Go down and back 2-3 times shoot from various depths and gaps space from the net. Then progress to another route adding passes etc etc... Note: Always stay on the same side to get forehand and back hand pass receives! Key Points: Hard passes with feet moving to build momentum Handling the puck in a prepared position

items.title: Full ice warm ups end to end alternate with timing and options - 10 mins
items.teaser: Full ice warm ups end to end alternate with timing and options - 10 mins
items.description: pos t o ONE side starts -> player skate over top of face -off circle - receives pass touches it back head up the wall get puck back from player (feet moving) go the other way continuous Key Points: Touch passes stick on the ice feet moving

items.title: full ice warm up end to end last progression - 10 mins
items.teaser: full ice warm up end to end last progression - 10 mins
items.description: All players start in one end. One side starts head towards the middle using the face off circle as a guide. turn towards the boards (outside) heading back to the line you started in receive a pass and pass it back (one touch puck exchange) Then go towards the other side just on top of the goalies crease... get a pass from that line and pass it right back again (one touch puck exchange) Continue wide to the boards the player you did the 2nd pass back to moves their feet with the puck toward the middle and passes it to the player going up the boards. Then after the pass up that player continues the drill by turning back to the line they came out of and continues the drill to the other side. Keep going until all players get a shot then come back the other way. Key Points: Direct and firm (hard) passes. Keep the puck on the forehand side all the way down the ice

items.title: Indirect passing with shots(2) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle both side start simultaneously. The F's located on the blue line facing in against the boards takes a couple of strides (staying wide) skating toward the face off dot and gives an in-direct (bank) pass the Defense man. The Defense man leaves the opposite face off dot on the same whistle starts backward (looking up ice) and pivots to forward to locate (search) the forwards pass off the boards (banked behind the net) The forward follows his initial pass (supporting the puck) then skates up ice just over the face off circle positioning to receive a return in- direct pass back from the Defense man. The forward makes any adjustments needed to control the pass from the defense man then takes the puck down to the other end and shoots. Key Points: Quick starts Full speed head up awareness Remember to switch sides

items.title: Transition Simulation relief to the D with an indirect pass up ice - 10 mins
items.teaser: Transition Simulation relief to the D with an indirect pass up ice - 10 mins
items.description: ey o ts Qu c sta ts u speed ead up a a e ess e e be to s tc s des This is a whistle generated drill. On the whistle the D's(at the blue line face off dot) start forward and skate into the zone and pivot to backward (heading toward the boards. The F's (at the blue line boards) delay slightly... take a couple of strides with the puck down the boards and pass to the D AFTER they pivot and are skating backward. After the pass the F swings deep across the zone toward the far side half wall (boards). The D steps up with the puck (re-pivot to skate forward) toward and in the same direction as the Forward and passes the puck back indirectly off the boards to the Forward who reacts/adjusts to get control/pick up the pick and go down into the other end to take a shot. Key Points: Defense men rotate. (pass only) Know angles and board densities (glass) etc etc...

items.title: Indirect passing with D-D and progressions - 10 mins
items.teaser: Indirect passing with D-D and progressions - 10 mins
items.description: This a whistle generated drill, both ends start simultaneously.Simulating D-D passing and transition. On the whistle the Forward skates towards the middle with a puck out of the deep corner and goes around the face off dot then passes the puck off the boards (in-direct) down ice to the defense man on the far blue line... who intern passes the puck to his partner (D-D pass). The initial forward follows the puck in support going around and staying out of the center ice circle. Then gets the pass back from the other Defense man and goes back into the same end and shoots. Key Points: Forwards always pass in, direct down the ice to the D. the D always pass D, D (for change of direction simulation) Forwards always shoot in the end they start from

items.title: proper retrieval with puck protection up the wall - 10 mins
items.teaser: proper retrieval with puck protection up the wall - 10 mins
items.description: c a ge o d ect o s u at o ) o a ds a ays s oot t e e d t ey sta t o This is a 2 part progression. Whistle generated. Players line up at both blue lines facing the net. Part 1. On the whistle... Players do an explosive 2-3 step start towards the net. Then skate into the corner on the side where the pucks are loosely placed for retrieval. The player retrieves the puck turning up ice, keeping it protected using the body as a shield. Once in control, gather speed through the neutral zone, over the blue line, drive wide (around the pre-set cones) and shoot. Part 2. 2 players leave on the whistle... The first player retrieves and the other goes across the blue line and sets a post up on the same side as the pucks. The retrieving player passes up to the posted up player on teh boards and follows teh pass the get a return give and go pass back. Both players then attack 2 on 0. Key Points: Quick start Shield the puck when retrieving 2 hands on the stick when retrieving

items.title: 2vs0 drop pass to puck exchange - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2vs0 drop pass to puck exchange - 10 mins
items.description: Pucks are place on the opposite adjacent blue lines with player at all 4 blue line boards positions. On the whistle 4 players start by skating along the blue line towards the middle. The player carrying the puck is always on top to be able to drop pass the other approaching player. After the drop pass, that player turns up ice slightly and makes an in-direct pass (exchanging pucks to each other)to the other 2 players who just did the same thing on the other side. (use the center ice red line boards as a guide to making the in-direct pass) Once getting control of the banked pass... Both players the turn back in transition to attack 2 on 0. Key Points: Stay on, side reaction and search. One pass maximum on attack. Then shoot! Go to the net!

items.title: 2vs0 pass to trailer,go to the net - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2vs0 pass to trailer,go to the net - 10 mins
items.description: et This is whistle generated. On the whistle the player leaves the blue line with a puck to build momentum... skate straight up the wall and pass to the player at the other blue line. That player receives the pass and leaves the puck for the initial player to pick up.(Give and Go Drive wide) Gain the zone with speed... The trailer lets the player go and drive wide (timing) then loops into the neutral zone and comes down the middle... LATE to ensure the trailer pass go BACK and toward the slot.(above the hash marks) This a quick release with both players going to the net. Key Points: accurate passses. *Use backhand to pass from the weak side* keep the puck protected. trail pass needs to go "back" up high.

items.title: 2vs0 rebound positioning - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the players use the neutral zone face off dots as a guide. The player with the puck skates to the dot and passes it across the ice to the other player who take it towards the net in the same end and takes the shot. After the initial pass... that player heads to the other end and acts as a rebound chaser. The shooter takes low hard shots enticing rebounds for BOTH players to react upon! Key Points: The shooter can look over their shoulder to see where the rebound player is.(timing) gravitate to shooters strong side to pounce on 2nd chance. Opportunities

items.title: 2vs0 headman the puck - 10 mins
items.description: g a tate to s oote s st o g s de to pou ce o d c a ce Oppo tu t es Whistle generated Alternate sides. 2 players leave on the whistle without a puck. Both skate diagonal across the ice staying out of the center ice circle! Player 1 receives a pass from the line and bumps it right back. (touch pass) Then takes some ice and gets to wall heading up ice through the neutral zone (wide). The line then passes the original puck to Player 2 who head mans (passes it up ice) it to Player 1. Player 1 drives wide with speed then passes it to Player 2 acting as a trailer. Player 2 has the quick shot with both players heading directly to the net! (blue paint) Key Points: Touch passes. tape to tape.

items.title: 2vs0 with D-D touch passes - 10 mins
items.description: ey o ts ouc passes tape to tape Whistle generated alternating ends (pucks on one side of the ice. One end starts... F's- pass to D Both F's swing deep behind the D and cross over and transition while the D's do touch passes with each other. (as many as possible) When the F's gain speed and head up the ice through the neutral zone one of the D'd pass the puck up keeping the F's on side. Once the F's get over the attacking blue line they make ONE pass maximum then shoot and go to the net (blue paint) Key Points: Alternate sides D, quick passes + timing F, stick on the ice + keep feet moving

items.title: 2vs0 drop pass with 1 transition - 10 mins
items.description: Whistle generated one side at a time Alternate. On the whistle both players skate toward the middle... The player with the puck is on top(closer to the blue line) The puck carrier does a drop pass to the other player coming across... They both turn up through the neutral zone... The new puck carrier passed the puck through the neutral zone to the line at the blue. That line receives the pass and can quickly sends it across to the other side (option of D-D simulation) OR just pass it back without the cross ice pass. The players in the drill do another cross to transition back. Receive the original puck back from the line ensuring to stay on side. Once over the blue on the attack... One pass maximum then shoot and both players head to the net. (blue paint) turn up pass to outlet. Key Points: Forward support puck if D, D simulation occurs. Locate stick target, quick pass. Max. 1 pass after entering zone the bolt F1s gravitate to the net.

items.title: Touch passes, Drive wide, Trailer pass - 10 mins
items.teaser: Touch passes, Drive wide, Trailer pass - 10 mins
items.description: pass a te e te g o e t e bo t s g a tate to t e et Whistle generated... F and D face to face... F skates backward, D skates forward up the wall and make 2-3 touch passes. F opens up go across the blue line to receive a pass from the D on the other side. F enters the O-zone driving wide and deep and makes a trailer pass to the supporting D following the play. F heads to the front of the net to screen/tip or deflect the D's shot. D-shot os low and hard Key Points: Timing and speed. Screen/tips+deflections

items.title: 2vs0 continuous with timing (transition) - 10 mins
items.description: Pucks are located at the opposite adjacent blue line boards with players in all 4 positions. A whistle to start the drill... then its continuous. On the whistle one side starts.(Players work in pairs) Player 1 skates straight up along the boards through the neutral zone and passes (pass 1) the puck to the player in the front of the line.(player 3) Then player 1 swings low goes across and heads up ice...(transition simulation) player 3 with the puck now passes the puck (pass 2) along the blue line to player 2 coming down and across in support. Player 2 passes (pass 3) it right back to player 3 (touch pass) then turns up ice. Now Player 3 move with the puck and can pass it back to player 1 or 2 (option) sending them back attacking 2 on 0. After player 3 passes the puck he then skates through the neutral zone down and across to the other side. Player 4 needs to read and be aware to skate down the boards and pass the puck to keep the drill continuous and going the other way alternating sides. Key Points: When entering offensive Zone 1 pass then shoot and attack the net. Hard passes off the transition. Everyone must be aware and ready.

items.title: Bump pass with timing - 10 mins
items.description: t a s t o e yo e ust be a a e a d eady Whistle generated. On the whistle, opposites go... skate overtop the circle, receive a pass and bump it right back. Go low to make time and space. Get the original puck passed back along the boards, then take shot. Key Points: bump passes (one, touch)

items.title: Neutral zone passing and transition - 10 mins
items.teaser: Neutral zone passing and transition - 10 mins
items.description: This is whistle generated. On the whistle the opposite adjacent players go. (2 players at a time) Skate with the puck straight up the boards and pass it ( Pass 1) just before getting to the center ice red line, straight forward to front player in the front of line. Stop on the Red line pivoting and skating back and towards the middle to receive the pass back (pass 2) while skating backwards... Re-pivot to forward with the puck, and pass the puck (pass 3) to the front player in line at the other side of the ice. That player advances the puck (pass 4) quickly up the boards to the front player in that line. The initial player (who started on the whistle) follows the puck through the neutral zone in support to receive it back (pass 5) and go in and shoot. On the next whistle the other players go the other way... Key Points: Accurate passing Quick feet *Puck support*

items.title: Neutral zone drop pass warm up - 10 mins
items.teaser: Neutral zone drop pass warm up - 10 mins
items.description: ey o ts ccu ate pass g Qu c eet uc suppo t On the whistle opposite adjacent players go. Skate with a puck to the center ice circle red line and drop pass the puck stationary (right on the line) pivot and skate backwards around center ice circle (transition) to retrieve the puck on the other side. Then go in and shoot. (The player did the same action drop passing their puck). They get your puck... you get theirs! (puck exchange) Key Points: The puck should remain stationary on the drop pass. (easier for retrieval) Keep low posture when pivoting retrieve at full speed. Quick release shots.

items.title: Neutral Zone warm up - 10 mins
items.description: This drill is whistle generated... Opposite diagonals go. On the whistle the players carry a puck towards the middle and continue through the neutral zone going all the way around the center face off circle then passes the puck to the opposite side first player in line.(from the same end they started from) Then heads toward the net and receives a pass from the same line the player started from. Go in and shoot.

items.title: Neutral zone warm up with stretch pass and timing (transition simulation) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Neutral zone warm up with stretch pass and timing (transition simulation) - 10 mins
items.description: This is a whistle generated drill. On the whistle opposite diagonals go. (Both ends start at the same time on the whistle) Leave the line skating backwards toward the nearest face off dot and receive a pass(1st pass) from your line. Pivot to forward with the puck and skate across the ice toward the other side and pass(2nd pass) the puck to the first player in the line on the other side. That player will pass(3rd pass) the puck up the boards through the neutral zone to the first player at the other blue line. Continue to skate around the center ice circle receiving a stretch pass (4th pass) from the original line you started from. Go attack into the other end and shoot. Key Points: Stay on, side when receiving the stretch pass! Stay outside of the center ice circle. Make hard passes.

items.title: Pass to D, delay for exchange (changing gears) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Pass to D, delay for exchange (changing gears) - 10 mins
items.description: a d passes Players situated at all four blue line boards with 2 Defense men at the middle blue line. On the whistle the opposite adjacent players go... Pass to the Defense man in front of you then delay to get the return pass from the Defense man who was beside you. He gets his puck from the player coming from the other side. Key Points: D, rotate after 5, 6 reps and always be in motion when receiving and giving passes.

items.title: Retrieval with pivots give and go single shot - 10 mins
items.teaser: Retrieval with pivots give and go single shot - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle opposite adjacent players go. Skate straight up and through the neutral zone... Retrieve a spotted puck placed just under the blue line... Pivot with the puck skating backwards to the middle the re-pivot and open up now skating forward and up ice. Pass the puck through the neutral to player at the front of the line across from where you started. Completing a give and go taking the puck in and shooting. (2 total passes) Next whistle... the next players go the other way. Key Points: Players need to spot pucks! Clean Pivots Pass in stride + Maintain momentum

items.title: Neutral zone stretch passing (stationary on the whistle) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Neutral zone stretch passing (stationary on the whistle) - 10 mins
items.description: Whistle generated... alternate sides. On the whistle 2 players from the same side head toward the center ice red line and do a tight turn around a pre-placed cone (depth can be changed) The opposite side players give a stationary stretch pass. Stay ON-SIDE! (straddle the blue line if required) try to attack from the dots! Key Points: Tight turns for quick transitions with stick on the ice! explosive starts on the whistle

items.title: Touch/stretch pass warm-up with timing (whistle) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Touch/stretch pass warm-up with timing (whistle) - 10 mins
items.description: ey o ts g t tu s o qu c t a s t o s t st c o t e ce e p os e sta ts o t e st e Diagonal opposites go (this is whistle generated) On the whistle the players (player 1) skate toward the middle and head up toward the center ice red line turning towards the boards now heading back to line where they started from. (completing a 360) The 2nd player in that line passes a puck and gets it right back in a pass exchange. Player 1 continues to skate across the ice along the blue line and receives a pass from the line on the other side and passes that puck right back in another pass exchange. Player 1 then does a tight turn around the neutral zone face off dot heading back toward the initial line they started from staying on-side. Player 1 then receives a stretch pass from the other end from the player who did the 2nd exchange pass. Player 1 takes the puck skates in on net and shoots. The other diagonal opposite players go on the next whistle. Remember to alternate lines. Key Points: Keep stick blades on the ice. 2 hands on the stick at all times. Feet constantly moving to maintain speed!

items.title: Continuous alternate (retrieve around the dots angle shots) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous alternate (retrieve around the dots angle shots) - 10 mins
items.description: This is a continuous drill started with a whistle. Pucks are placed loosely in the neutral zone. Players line up at the blue lines against the boards. (4 lines) Opposites adjacent players go along the blue line toward the middle then turn into the neutral zone, retrieve a puck. Continue with the puck around the near face off dot (completing a 360 degree turn) going in on an angle and shooting. The other players go once the shot is taken. (always alternating sides. Slow frequency allowing the goalies time to re- set and get across the net to cover their angles Key Points: Retrieve the puck with 2 hands on your stick keeping puck protection in mind. minimize skating cross overs (do tight turns) Make sure the shot is taken before the next player goes

items.title: 4 bump back passes around neutral - 10 mins
items.teaser: 4 bump back passes around neutral - 10 mins
items.description: s at g c oss o e s (do t g t tu s) a e su e t e s ot s ta e be o e t e e t p aye goes Whistle generated. On the whistle opposite adjacent players go. Start backwards and back up and out towards the face off dot. Get a quick pass from the same line (while going backward) you started from right after the whistle. Pivot to forward and go clockwise around the center ice circle receiving passes and bumping (passing) the puck directly to all the lines. Receive the 5th pass from the original line your started from and go in and shoot! On the next whistle... the other adjacent players go the other (counter clockwise) way. Key Points: 2 players going at a time. Keep sticks on the ice. keep feet moving. Everyone head up and aware!

items.title: 3 pass timing around the center face off circle with a single shot - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 pass timing around the center face off circle with a single shot - 10 mins
items.description: This is a whistle generated drill. Please line up at the opposite adjacent neutral zone face off dots. On the whistle the first players (player 1) skates along the blue line (without a puck) toward the middle and receive a pass (pass 1) from the 2nd player (player 2) in the other line. Now with the puck Player 1 heading around the center ice circle (towards player 2 in the other line)and passes (pass 2) the puck right back to player 2. Player 1 continues around the center ice circle and receives a pass (pass 3) from Player 2 in the original line they started from. Staying on-side going into the other end to shoot! Key Points: Stick on the ice! Firm accurate passes Remember to switch sides.

items.title: Neutral zone D-D simulation stretch pass to a shot - 10 mins
items.teaser: Neutral zone D-D simulation stretch pass to a shot - 10 mins
items.description: ey o ts St c o t e ce accu ate passes e e be to s tc s des On the whistle the player in the opposite adjacent lines go. Player 1 skates up and receives a pass (pass 1) from the player in in the directly on front of them. Player 1 taking a few stride into the middle passes (pass 2) the puck across the ice to front player in that line. That player simulates a D-D cross ice pass (pass 3) to the player where the puck originally came from. Player 1 continues around the center ice circle staying on side and receives the original puck stretched passed (pass 4) goes in and shoots! Key Points: Everyone aware! Tape to tape passing!

items.title: Neutral zone face off dots warm ups Pattern 1 - 10 mins
items.teaser: Neutral zone face off dots warm ups Pattern 1 - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle opposite adjacent players go. In this pattern Player 1 leaves the line with a puck.. Skate straight ahead and pass (pass 1) to the first player in line. Player 1 then skates below the blue line (to make time for the other players to complete a passing sequence) continuing around and using the center ice circle as a guide. Passes 2 and 3 are a D-D and back to D simulation. Pass 4 is then made to Player 1 staying on- side receiving the pass going in and taking a shot. On the next whistle, the other players go the other way! Key Points: 2 players are executing the drill on each whistle. Done at control and timing speed ensuring to stay on, side. All players, heads up and aware.

items.title: Neutral zone face off dots warm ups Patterns 2 - 10 mins
items.teaser: Neutral zone face off dots warm ups Patterns 2 - 10 mins
items.description: e su g to stay o , s de p aye s, eads up a d a a e On the whistle opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 leaves with a puck. Skate straight ahead and pass (pass 1) the puck to the first player in front of the line. (straight ahead) Player 1 crosses the center red line and pivots to backward (always facing the puck) then re- pivots to forward (doing a 360 degree circle) and skates to the middle. Pass 2 is a D-D simulated pass. Pass 3 is passed up ice to Player 1 who stays on-side receives the pass goes in and shoots. On the next whistle the other players go the other way! Key Points: 2 players are doing the drill on each whistle. The drill is executed at a control and timing speed. Players should pivot low to make time for the passing sequence. Always face the puck when pivoting.

items.title: Neutral zone warm up with Pivots, D-D and transition simulation - 10 mins
items.teaser: Neutral zone warm up with Pivots, D-D and transition simulation - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 starts without a puck and receives pass 1 and skates with it towards the middle and passes it (Pass 2) across the ice to the front player in that line. Player 1 then proceeds to pivot and skate around the center ice face off circle (always facing the puck) Pass 3 is a D-D simulation(the puck passed back to the initial line where Player 1 started. Player 1 then re-pivots to forward and receives pass 4 and goes in and shoots! On the next whistle the other players go the other way! Key Points: Hard passes, tape to tape! Always face the puck. Stay outside of the center ice circle Timing and control speed.

items.title: Quick touch passes quick feet around the center face off circle - 10 mins
items.teaser: Quick touch passes quick feet around the center face off circle - 10 mins
items.description: g a d co t o speed 1 or 2 players (Option or progress) Line up by the cone/s On the whistle Receive a pass from the line (1 or 2 depending on the number of player/s at the comes) Exchange a puck stationary (touch passes) then immediately Skate around the center ice face off circle heading toward the other line. Exchange another touch pass again now in motion. Continue around and through the neutral zone and receive pass across the blue from original line you started from. Key Points: 1 or 2 players at a time can do this drill. Remember to switch sides. After the initial 1st touch pass, players should be at full speed while skating around the face off circle. Passes need to be quick and accurate. Sticks on the ice the whole time!

items.title: Double give and go transition, D passing with mobility and support - 10 mins
items.teaser: Double give and go transition, D passing with mobility and support - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 does a give and go pass to the D located at the blue line in the middle. Player 1 receives the puck back and skates with the puck through the neutral zone swinging low (around and behind the other D) turning back up ice and back through the neutral zone again. After the D executes the give and go (touch) pass. The then skates over to the far side boards (stopping stationary) to receive the 2nd give and go (touch) pass from Player 1 gaining speed through the neutral zone. The D passes the puck back to player 1 who goes in and shoots. The D then skates back to the middle blue line (resets) ready for the next whistle to go the other way. Key Points: D's needs to be active and mobile always supporting with sticks on the ice. D's rotate (when not in they can be shooters)

items.title: 2 shot drill with timing and positioning - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shot drill with timing and positioning - 10 mins
items.description: ( e ot t ey ca be s oote s) On the whistle player 1 (blue) skates forward with a puck and passes it to player 2 (green) who skates around his line with the puck and passes if back to player 1 (blue) who goes in and shoots and goes to the line at the boards (red) After player 2 (green) passes the puck back to player 1. Player 2 swings low and toward the boards turning up ice ready to receive a pass from player 3 (red) Player 3 (red) with timing takes a puck and skates to the middle, turns up ice and passes the puck to player 2 (green) who goes all the way down the ice and shoots. After player 3 (red passes the puck they go to the green line in the middle. After Player 2 (green) shoots, they go to the blue line. Completing a rotation after each sequence initiated by a whistle start. Key Points: Call for the passes (communicate) Timing with heads up awareness. Elevated focus and attention.

items.title: Single shot drill with timing and support advancing through the neutral zone - 10 mins
items.teaser: Single shot drill with timing and support advancing through the neutral zone - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle player 1 (green) starts with a puck with patience waiting for player 2 (blue) to skate forward and transition to backward back into the end zone. Once player 2 (blue) is skating backwards... player one (green) skates directly toward player 2 (blue) and passes (pass 1) them the puck. Player 1 (green) does a tight turn towards the boards and up ice. Player 2 (blue) re-pivots to forward and steps up and passes (pass 2) the puck back to player 1 (green). Player 2 now goes to the green line. Player 1 (green) skates over the red line and passes (pass 3) the puck to player 3 (red) who with timing skated up and turned into the middle with timing and support takes the puck in and shoots. Player 1 (green) goes to the red line. After the shot player 3 (red) goes to the blue line. Completing the sequence and rotation. Key Points: Patience for timing,After the whistle player 1 (green needs to wait for player 2 (blue) to pivot to and skate backwards before passing the 1st pass.

items.title: Double transition figure 8 with a single shot - 10 mins
items.teaser: Double transition figure 8 with a single shot - 10 mins
items.description: p ot to a d s ate bac a ds be o e pass g t e st pass On the whistle the opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 leaves with a puck heading into and through the neutral zone and passes (pass 1) it to the D. Then turn towards the boards (1st transition) and receive the pass (pass 2) back from the D. Go up and in towards the middle and pass (pass 3) the puck to the other D. Then turn towards the boards again heading up ice (2nd transition) Receive the puck back (pass 4) and take it down into the other end and shoot! On the next whistle the other players go the other way. Key Points: Call for passes Sticks on the ice D's rotate

items.title: Angle passing with transition and a single shot (2 options) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Angle passing with transition and a single shot (2 options) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the opposite diagonal players go. OPTION A: Player 1 skates with a puck straight forward and passes (pass 1) straight ahead to Player 2. Player 1 swings low and turns toward the boards and heads up ice. Player 2, now with the puck steps (skates) into the middle and turns up ice and passes (pass 2) the puck back to player 1 who goes in and shoots. (both players switch, go to opposite lines) OPTION B: (Progression)Player 1 skates with a puck straight forward and passes (pass 1) straight ahead to Player 2. Player 1 swings low and turns toward the boards and heads up ice. Player 2, now with the puck steps (skates) into the middle and turns up ice and passes (pass 2) the puck back to player 1. Player 1 after receiving the pass turns into the middle swinging low and turns up ice with the puck. Player 2 turns towards the boards and turns up ice ready to receive the puck back again. Player 1 passes (pass 3) the puck back to player 2 who goes in and shoots. OPTION B is a double transition! Key Points: After receiving the first pass... always step into the middle. Swing low and tight when changing direction. Keep sticks on the ice setting solid targets. Keep the feet moving, maintaining speed.

items.title: Warm up retrievals pass to the D (mobility) and transition - 10 mins
items.teaser: Warm up retrievals pass to the D (mobility) and transition - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 skates directly to the loose pucks located in the center ice circle. Retrieve a puck and pass it to the defense man who should be in motion skating backward. Player 1 then proceeds to skate towards the boards swinging low turning up ice to receive the pass back from the Defense man and goes in and shoots. On the next whistle the other players go the other way. The Defense man needs to get to the center ice and re-pivot to backwards again, ready to receive the pass. Alternating sides on each whistle. Key Points: Kick starts on the whistle. Hard passes to the D's Tight turns go wide or face the puck.

items.title: Single shot drill with stops, starts and transition - 10 mins
items.teaser: Single shot drill with stops, starts and transition - 10 mins
items.description: ey o ts c sta ts o t e st e a d passes to t e s g t tu s go de o ace t e puc On the whistle opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 skates with a puck all the way around the center ice circle. Pivoting to backwards then re-pivoting to forward always facing up ice. Player 1 then passes (pass 1) the puck to the line straight ahead and skates to that same side neutral zone face off dot and stops on it. Player 2 passes (pass 2) the puck to player 3 straight up the boards. Player 1 follows the direction of the puck gaining speed through the neutral zone and gets the pass (pass 3) and goes in and shoots! On the next whistle the other players go the other way. Key Points: Puck control while pivoting. complete stopping and explosive starts.

items.title: 2 shot drill with multiple elements, timing and trailer support - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shot drill with multiple elements, timing and trailer support - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle player 1 (red) skates down the wall without a puck and receives a pass (pass 1) from player 2 (blue). Player 1 (red) turns to the middle around the cone and heads back up ice with the puck and passes (pass 2) back to player 2 (blue) who is heading up through the neutral zone. Player 2 (blue) after passing (pass 3) the puck to player 3 (green) receives a pass (pass 4) from the coach out of the corner and shoots. Player 3 Green steps (skates) into the middle and turns up ice with the puck joining player 1 (red) in a 2 on 0. Player 3 (green) advances (pass 5) the puck to player 1 (red) who drives wide and deep with the option to shoot or pass back to player 3 (green) trailing and coming in late looking for a pass or drive the net looking for a rebound. Key Points: Timing and pass execution.

items.title: Continuous passing with pivots and a single shot) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous passing with pivots and a single shot) - 10 mins
items.description: ey o ts g a d pass e ecut o On the whistle opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 (blue) takes 2 steps forward into the middle then pivots immediately to backward. Exchange a pass with the player behind you (touch pass 1 and 2) while skating backward. Re-pivot to forward and head through the neutral zone and do another pass exchange (touch passes 3 and 4) with the player at the front of the line. Player 1 (blue) then swings low in a tight turn toward the boards and heads up ice. Player 2 (red) takes 2 steps and passes (pass 5) the puck back to player 2 (blue) who goes in and shoots! Player 2 (red) immediately pivots to backward receives a pass exchange to keep the drill going the other way! (Keeping it continuous) Key Points: Timing and Awareness! Head on a swivel! After shot alternate lines.

items.title: Continuous carousel with a specific route (transition simulation) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous carousel with a specific route (transition simulation) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle 2 players leave at the same time then the drill remains continuous. Player 1 from each line skates with out a puck over top of the end zone face off circle towards the middle and heads up through the neutral zone continuing to skate around the center ice face off circle. Going all the way around the center face off circle heading back towards the line they just left from. Player 2 leaves the line at the same time with a puck skate around the same side end zone face off dot. (pivoting around the dot to always face up ice) When player 2 start to skate up ice with the puck then locates player 1, who should be coming straight at player 2, Player 2 passes the puck to player 1. Player 1 receives the pass and carries the puck all the way around the center ice face off circle goes into the other (far) end and shoots! Player 2 after the pass jumps into the same route player 1 did to keep the drill continuous. The next player (3) in line keeps the drill going by skating with a puck around the closest face off dot and following the same route continuously. Key Points: Always be ready. The next player in the line needs to time their starts having their head up reading the drill. Always follow the same route. Remember to switch sides.

items.title: proper retrieval with puck protection up the wall - 10 mins
items.teaser: proper retrieval with puck protection up the wall - 10 mins
items.description: This is a 2 part progression. Whistle generated. Players line up at both blue lines facing the net. Part 1. On the whistle... Players do an explosive 2-3 step start towards the net. Then skate into the corner on the side where the pucks are loosely placed for retrieval. The player retrieves the puck turning up ice, keeping it protected using the body as a shield. Once in control, gather speed through the neutral zone, over the blue line, drive wide (around the pre-set cones) and shoot. Part 2. 2 players leave on the whistle... The first player retrieves and the other goes across the blue line and sets a post up on the same side as the pucks. The retrieving player passes up to the posted up player on teh boards and follows teh pass the get a return give and go pass back. Both players then attack 2 on 0. Key Points: Quick start Shield the puck when retrieving 2 hands on the stick when retrieving

items.title: 3 part give and go progressive warm up - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 part give and go progressive warm up - 10 mins
items.description: ey o ts Qu c sta t S e d t e puc e et e g a ds o t e st c e et e g Option (A) 1 player goes on the whistle Leave the line with a puck and skate directly across the blue line and pass the puck to the player in front of the opposite side line they pass teh puck right back completing a give and go. Carry the puck along teh dot line through the neutral zone collecting speed, go in and shoot! Option (B) 2 players leave on the whistle one with a puck and dows the same route. The opposite side player can pass the puck back to any of the 2 players. They do a drive wide 2vs0 simulation with a 1 pass option once over the blue line then shoot and go to the net. Option (C) 3 players go on the whistle. When attacking over teh blue line the player with the puck drives wide, one player drives the net and the 3rd player, acting as the trailer sets the attack triangle with a maximum one pass option then shoot and go to the net. Key Points: Always start with option A and progress. Get the puck to the net with speed and control. Tape to tape passes.

items.title: 2 shot warm up with a touch pass and screen/tip - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shot warm up with a touch pass and screen/tip - 10 mins
items.description: Whistle generated. 2 players from each line go on each whistle. Always use the neutral zone face off dots as a guide. In this diagram the players are always turning right (tight turns around the face off dots) Player 1 (blue) Skates up through the neutral zone and does a tight turn (right) around the face off dot and heads back toward the line he came from. Player 2 (green) Skates across the blue line and does a tight turn (right) around the far side face off dot and heads back toward the same line he came from. Player 3 passes (pass 1) a puck to player 2 (green) who immediately bump passes (pass 2) the puck to player 1 (blue) who takes the pass goes in and shoots (shot 1) check for a rebound and then set up a screen or ready to tip/deflect the 2nd shot. After passing the puck to player 1... Player 2 (green) skates around the center ice face off circle (going left) and receives a pass (pass 3) from Player 3 (in the line) goes in and shoots (shot 2) through the screen set up by player 1 (blue). Key Points: Stick on the ice. Timing and position awareness. Go on the whistle and remember to switch sides.

items.title: 2 shots with multiple passes, transitions and screens/tips/deflections - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shots with multiple passes, transitions and screens/tips/deflections - 10 mins
items.description: A whistle generated drill. F1 leaves the line with a puck. F1 and the D does 3 passes. The 1st pass (pass 1) is early the D passes it (pass 2) back to F1 right away. F1 bumps (pass 2) the puck back again to the D. (3 total passes), Then F1 goes around the D heading up ice and receives the same puck (pass 4) and goes in and shoots. F1 stays in front of the net for the 2nd shot (to screen and/or tip/deflect). Once F1 receives the 4th pass then crosses over the center ice red line going in to shoot... F2 can start. (timing) F2 skates with a puck toward the D and passes (pass 1) it to the D. F2 then skates just past the center ice red line and posts up (stationary) and receives the puck (pass 2) back from the D and goes in from that same side and shoots through the screen set up by F1. Key Points: Keep the feet moving. Stand in front of the goalie. Timing + Awareness.

items.title: 3 shot drill with retrievals a chip pass and a point shot - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shot drill with retrievals a chip pass and a point shot - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the coach soft dumps the puck to the top of the face circle. The D starts forward turns to backward (to look up ice) then re-pivots to forward again and retrieves the puck. On the whistle F1 (blue) goes over to the boards/wall and posts up stationary and receives the pass (pass 1) from the D. F2 (green) skates around the face off circle (in support) gains speed through the neutral zone and gets a chip pass (pass 2) from F1 (blue) off the boards then goes in and shoots (shot 1) and stays in front of the net. After the chip pass, F1 (blue) skates down into the corner and retrieves a puck and take it to the net and shoots (shot 2) from a hard angle through a screen set up by F2 (green). After the 2nd shot F2 (green) goes to the corner and retrieves a puck and passes (pass 3) it to D (red) who followed the play up and is sitting (stationary) at the point near the blue line. After the point pass F2 (green) goes back to the front of the net with F1 (blue) and sets up a double screen awaiting the point shot (shot 3) from the D. Key Points: Both ends at the same time. Timing and positioning. Low point shots. Remember to switch sides.

items.title: Warm up transition simulation (continuous) - 10 mins
items.description: arm up transition simulation (continuous) - 10 mins On the whistle, one side starts. Blue player starts without a puck, goes around the center face off circle, swinging close to the blue line heading back through the neutral zone. Green Player from the other side passes with their feet moving and keeps the drill continuous going the other way. y Points: Pass with feet moving. Can open up to the puck if required. Remember to do th sides.

items.title: warm up middle blue into the end zone transition - 10 mins
items.teaser: warm up middle blue into the end zone transition - 10 mins
items.description: arm up middle blue into the end zone transition - 10 mins On the whistle. Players line up in the middle at the blue lines, facing into the end zones. The first player leaves the line with a puck and passes it to the coach, then swings deep and wide into the pre-determined direction of the drill. The coach passes the puck back to the player when heading back up the ice. The player receives the pass form the coach then skates down to the other end and shoots. y Points: Remember to change the direction of the drill after a certain amount of shots per yer or a certain amount of time. Players can sub in as passers for the coaches.

items.title: Warm up middle blue into the neutral zone transition back (face the puck) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Warm up middle blue into the neutral zone transition back (face the puck) - 10 mins
items.description: ns This drill can be whistle generated or timed by the players. Pucks and players are located at the middle blue lines on both sides facing the neutral zone. Players start skating backward into the neutral zone to quickly receive a short quick pass from the line and pass it back. (touch pass exchange) Players then open up with a pivot, then go in the pre-determined direction and receive the pass back from the line prior to going around the cone. Prior to the blue line, the player carrying the puck passes the puck to the last player in the line for a give and go pass simulation. The player receives it back and goes in and shoots. y Points: Remember to switch directions after a certain number of shots or a certain mount of time.

items.title: Continuous back check after shot (coaches pass) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous back check after shot (coaches pass) - 10 mins
items.description: ntinuous back check after shot (coaches pass) - 10 mins Players line up (behind the goal line) in opposite diagonal corners. To start the drill 2 players (one out of each corner) skates the length of the ice (with a puck) and can shoot from anywhere after passing over the blue line. The shot release is the cue for the next player to start heading up ice (without a puck) ready to receive a cross ice pass from a coach. The shooter (immediately after their shot) becomes a back checker to apply aggressive pressure on the player now heading down ice for the shot. The drill is continuous. y Points: Player leaves after shot is taken. Coach's pass. Players start behind goal line! ating and shooting under pressure. Remember to do both sides.

items.title: Continuous D-D point shots, screens and defelctions - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous D-D point shots, screens and defelctions - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle. One side starts. (Blue F) Go through the face off circle above the face off dot and take a shot. (check for a rebound and play it) Then immediately proceed to the loose puck pile on the same side you started from. Retrieve a puck and pass back to that same side D1. Then immediately get back to the front of the net. D1 who received the pass (pass 1) passes the puck across the blue line to D2 (D to D pass). D2 Shoots with the forward in front of the net/goalie (screen/deflection). After the shot, the forward plays any possible rebound then immediately goes to the puck pile on the other side of the net, and retrieves a puck and passes it back to D2 then gets back in front of the net. D2 passes it across the blue line to D1 (D-D pass) D1 shoots with the forward back in front the net/goalie. After the 2nd point shot, the forward plays any possible rebound then the forward goes back to that same side puck pile to retrieve a puck and pass it (pass 3) to the forward (green F) on that side to continue the drill with the same actions going the other way. y Points: Explosive stops and starts. Straight line routes. Low point shots D, D passing. od net presence and positioning.

items.title: Continuous goalie pass to outlet (breakout simulation) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous goalie pass to outlet (breakout simulation) - 10 mins
items.description: See the blue and green player starting positions. A whistle to start the drill then it becomes continuous. On the whistle the blue and green player under the blue line in the offensive zones start with a puck and give the goalies a firm hard pass that they can handle and control. On the initial pass to the goalies, the players (red) at the blue line boards (with timing) drop down and post up stationary at the hash marks (simulating a break out). The goalies pass the puck to the players (red) who pass the puck back to the initial players (green and blue) who started the drill. The other players (green and blue) who lined up outside the blue line (with timing) swing into the middle to receive a pass (pass 4), go through the neutral zone, pass over the blue line and pass the puck to the goalies to continue the drill. The yellow lines indicate where to go in the rotation while the drill remains continuous.

items.title: Continuous passing with pivots and a single shot - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous passing with pivots and a single shot - 10 mins
items.description: ntinuous passing with pivots and a single shot - 10 mins On the whistle opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 (blue) takes 2 steps forward into the middle then pivots immediately to backward. Exchange a pass with the player behind you (touch pass 1 and 2) while skating backward. Re-pivot to forward and head through the neutral zone and do another pass exchange (touch passes 3 and 4) with the player at the front of the line. Player 1 (blue) then swings low in a tight turn toward the boards and heads up the ice. Player 2 (red) takes 2 steps and passes (pass 5) the puck back to player 1 (blue) who goes in and shoots! Player 2 (red) immediately pivots to backward and receives a pass exchange to keep the drill going the other way! (Keeping it continuous) y Points: Timing and Awareness! Head on a swivel! After the shot alternate lines.

items.title: Continuous soft dump cycle with 2 options - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous soft dump cycle with 2 options - 10 mins
items.description: Offensive cycle drill with 2 variations. Option A- Up the boards Starting in the middle of the ice at the blue line, Player 1 (blue) softly dumps the puck into the right side corner and proceeds to go and retrieve it and skate with the puck up the boards. Then drop passes the puck (off the boards at the hash marks is best) to the supporting player 2 (green) following the same route coming in to pick up the cycle pass. After the drop pass, player 1 (blue) continues over and around the face off circle (with their stick on the ice) ready to receive the puck back from player 2 (green) then passes back to player 1 (blue) who takes a shot and goes back to the line. Immediately after, player 2 (green) sets up the shot, skates directly into the other (left) corner to keep the drill continuous. The next player in the line softly dumps a puck into the corner and follows in support to keep the drill going the other way/side. Option B- Reverse cycle. Player 1 (green) softly dumps into the right side corner proceeds to retrieve the puck and skates up the boards with the puck. Drop passes the puck off the boards at the hash marks and continues over top and around the face off circle ready to receive the puck back from player 2 (blue). Player 2 (blue) skates to the boards (same side right side) and heads down the wall retrieves the puck skating under the goal line towards the net and passes the puck back to Player 1 (green) Player 1 (green) takes the shot and goes back into line. Player 2 (after the pass) immediately goes to the other side corner to retrieve the softly dumped puck to continue the drill going the other way. y Points Timing + cycle passes using the boards A ) Up the boards B ) reverse and down

items.title: Continuous swings with angle passes - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous swings with angle passes - 10 mins
items.description: Whistle to start the drill. Players start with a puck at the top of the face off circles, go in and take a shot. Immediately continue into the corner to retrieve a puck. The remaining players in their lines (1 at theblue line boards and 2 at the center ice face off circle) with timing swing low in support ready to receive a pass. The players at the blue line boards, swing low into the middle. The players at the center ice face off circle swing low towards the boards. After the shot and retrieval, 2 passes are made to the swinging players moving the puck up the ice to keep the drill continuous and rotating. The yellow lines indicate where to go after the passes are made. y Points: Deep support stick on the ice. Angle passes. Timing + positioning

items.title: Continuous warm up with timing and positioning - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous warm up with timing and positioning - 10 mins
items.description: The drill starts on a whistle then remains continuous. On the whistle to start the drill, player 1 located just below the face off circle beside the net, goes behind the net and retrieves a puck and passes it (pass 1) to player 2 at the hash marks (break out simulation) who started at the face off dot outside the blue line on that same side Player 2 then skates across the ice and down the boards (to post up at the hash marks) and receives the pass from player 1. Player 3 (the shooter), starts at the boards at center ice, skates across the ice along the center red line, goes down the boards heading back the other way (similar to a 360 degree circle), swinging low through the face off circles in support to receive the pass (pass 2) from player 2 located at the hash marks. Player 3 now with the puck, goes down and shoots and keeps the drill continuous by turning into player 1, by immediately retrieving a puck after the shot behind the net, continuing the drill and completing the rotation. The yellow lines indicates where to rotate to. y Points: To start the drill, Player 1 (retrieves and passes to player 2) Then rotates to yer 2 line. Player 2 (posts up at the hash marks and passes to player 3) Then rotates to yer 3 line. Player 3 (Long skate 360°, supports the break out pass) Go down and shoot! rning into player 1 continuing the rotation.

items.title: Continuous warm-ups full ice using cones - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous warm-ups full ice using cones - 10 mins
items.description: Whistle to start the drill then it becomes continuous. On the whistle, 2 players start with a puck by skating out of corners going all the way down the ice along the boards, proceeding past the far blue line around the cone and passes (pass 1) the puck to the front player (who moved out a bit) in the opposite line. The players continue skating across the ice swinging low, going in front of the player they passed the puck to and turning at the boards heading up ice. The players now receive the return pass (pass 2) while heading up the ice, proceed to go down the ice and shoot at the net in the same end you started from. To keep the drill continuous, after the return pass is made that player skates over top of the cone and gets a puck passed out (pass 3) from the line they just came out of, and proceeds to continue the drill and do the same.

items.title: Continuous with retrievals cross crease timing and positioning (one timers) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Continuous with retrievals cross crease timing and positioning (one timers) - 10 mins
items.description: ns A player (green) sets up at the side of the net near the face off dot. A Whistle to start the drill. The blue player, starts with a puck, goes in from the blue line and shoots checking for a rebound, and plays it if necessary. Continue to the loose puck pile on the same side beside the net, retrieve a puck and pass it to the green player across the crease and stays there (stop and set up after the pass). The green player shoots. Both players can play any possible rebound. Right after the shot and rebound battle, the green player goes to the loose puck pile and retrieves a puck and passes it up to the next (green) player at the blue line, who come in, shoots and continues the drill from the other side. This drill is done out of both ends. y Points: Quick release! Stick blade on the ice for ONE Timers or redirect shots. Play any ssible rebounds.

items.title: 2 shot 3vs0 transition and timing strategy - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shot 3vs0 transition and timing strategy - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, the blue player located in the middle of the ice at the blue line facing into the neutral zone, starts skating with a puck up into the neutral zone, swings high turning right. The blue player passes to the red player (located on the blue at the boards facing into the neutral zone), who with timing swings (just below the blue player) into the middle. The green player delays and attacks (without going offside) with timing and receives a pass from the red player (red player goes to the net after the pass). The green player shoots. (shot 1) After the first shot the blue player delays and with timing, stops at the puck pile, retrieves a loose puck from the hash mark area, skates over the face off circle and shoots (shot 2). The green and red players should be located in front of the net, setting screens, ready to jump on any possible rebound. y Points: Timing + positioning. Quick release shooting. Attack the net after shots.

items.title: 2 Shot Double net drive puck protection with pressure - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 Shot Double net drive puck protection with pressure - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, 2 players leave from each line (3rd player needs to make 2 passes). 1st player (blue) skates with a puck over the dot and shoots (shot 1), then curls to the middle to locate the 2nd player (green) and apply pressure. On the initial whistle, the 2nd player (green) goes around a cone (left tight turn,inside to outside), receives a pass from the 3rd player in line, drives the net and shoots through the pressure from player 1 (the blue player). After the pressure and the 2nd shot is taken, player 1 (blue) turns toward the boards (right tight turn) and heads up the middle of the ice (breakout simulation). Player 2 (green) who just took the shot, supports the line and receives a pass (pass 2) up the middle from the 3rd player in the line. Player 2 (green) passes the puck up to player 1 who heads up ice to shoot at the other end. After the pass, player 2 recovers to apply pressure on Player 1 (blue) coming in from the other end. Both ends go at the same time y Points: Timing! Apply just enough pressure allowing for shots to be taken. Accurate ssing.

items.title: 2 shot drill with retrieval and point shot (break out simulation) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shot drill with retrieval and point shot (break out simulation) - 10 mins
items.description: This drill is whistle generated. On the whistle both ends start simultaneously. The D's start forward from the board side hash marks and skate up to the top of the circle and pivot to backward, proceed down to the bottom of the circle then re-pivot to forward (using the face off circle as a guide). The D then retrieves a loose puck and skates with it toward the blue line (D passes the puck to the supporting F). On the initial whistle the F leaves the center ice red line (at the boards), skates straight down into the zone going under the other face off circle and turning up the ice through the middle, in front of the net in support to receive a pass from the D. Proceeding to go down to the other end to shoot (simulating a breakout and taking shot #1), staying in front of the net and prepare to set a screen and or tip/deflect the point shot. After the D passes to the F. The D continues up ice through the neutral zone and skates around the center ice circle (always facing up ice *Pivots required* buying time). The D then goes across the ice and retrieves a preset puck just under the blue line. The D drags or walks with the puck toward the middle and takes a point shot (shot #2). y Points: Timing and change of speed. (acceleration through the neutral zone) Low hard nt shots. Set screen as close to the blue crease paint as possible.

items.title: 2 shot neutral zone transition (tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle both sides start simultaneously. The D (red) skates with a puck across the ice, starting at the boards from the hash marks and passes the puck to the forward (stationary) on the other side. The defense man pivots to backward skating through the neutral zone along the face off dot line. The forward comes off the wall with the puck turning up into the middle of the ice and begins to pass the puck with the D along the face off dot line (maintaining a consistent gap), passing 3-4 times (exchanging the puck back and forth) through the neutral zone until crossing over the blue line. Once over the blue line, the F skates across and in front of the D, swinging wide towards the boards, turning up the ice (transition), gets the puck back from the D and carries it down (into the same end they started from) and shoots (shot 1) then sets a screen in front of the goalie/net awaiting for a point shot from the D. After the D passes (pass 5) to send the forward off to shoot, he follows the F across the center red line, then circles back around the center face off circle and stops just inside the blue line (at the point,same side as the coach). The D then receives a pass (pass 6) from the coach (who is located in the corner with pucks) and shoots (shot 2) low and hard with the F already in front of the net. y Points: Forwards should keep their sticks on the ice at all times. Low shots from the nt.

items.title: 2 shot retrieval with point shot (tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shot retrieval with point shot (tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.description: 4 cones are placed on all the neutral zone face off dots (nearest the blue lines) On the whistle, Both ends start simultaneously (F's and D's go at the same time) The F's (blue) skate around the cone into the center ice circle and retrieve a puck. The D's skate forward and pivot to backwards (around the cone) once the D's skating backwards and go over the blue line the F's pass (pass 1) the D's the puck. The F's continue under the cones (swinging low) on the other side and turn up ice (close to the boards). The D's step up (stop and skate forward) and pass (pass 2) the puck back to the F's who skate it down and shoots (shot 1 from the slot) and stays in front of the goalie/net (sets up screen). After the the 2nd pass the D's skate over top of the cone towards the line they came from and receive a pass (pass 3) from the next Dman in the line, then goes and shoots (shot 2) from close to the blue line (long shot, low and hard). y Points: F's should pass to the D's when they are skating backwards.

items.title: 2 shot timing full ice (tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.description: Both ends (all players) start simultaneously on the whistle. 4 cones are placed close to the end zone face off dots. Start without a puck, skate over the cone closest to your line, then across the ice under the cone on the other side. The blue players receive a pass (pass 1) from the red line and skate up around the cone and pass (pass 2) the puck across the ice to the red player, who has skated the same route the other way. The red player stays on that side of the ice and goes down the ice and shoots (shot 1) from the slot, stays in front of the goalie/net and sets up a screen. The blue player follows his pass(pass 2) across the ice and receives a pass (pass 3) from the same line they started from (blue line) and goes down and takes a longer shot (shot 2) with the red player waiting in front of the net. y Points: Shoot and stay in front for Screen/deflections. Precise passes. Low shots. member to switch sides.

items.title: 2 shot timing with retrievals (using Coaches or Defensemen) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shot timing with retrievals (using Coaches or Defensemen) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the blue players do a give and go pass (pass 1 and 2) with the coaches, heading up ice into and through the neutral zone. Blue players now take the puck, go the length of the ice and shoot. (shot 1). Right after the shot, blue players go to the same side corner (in this description, turning right) and retrieve a loose puck and head up the boards with it. Upon the retrieval, the red players (with timing) start skating across the ice ready to receive a pass (pass 3) from the blue players. The red players go down the ice to take a shot (shot 2). After the rep sequence the players switch lines. y Points: Red player line delay and timing.

items.title: 2 shot timing with transition - 10 mins
items.description: Whistle generated. On the whistle the green player (located at center near the boards) starts with a puck, skates straight down the wall and passes (pass 1) the puck to the blue player located at the hash marks on the boards). The green player swings low and turns right heading into the middle going back up ice. (transition) The blue player passes (pass 2) the puck back to the green player. After the pass the blue player now skates through the neutral zone and retrieves and loose puck (just under the same side blue line) and takes it in to shoot (shot 1) With timing the red player leaves the wall and receives a pass (pass 3) in the slot area from the green player who skates with the puck through the neutral zone. The green player then swings (turning left) towards the boards and heads up ice back into the neutral zone (transition) The red player skates up the ice with the puck and returns the pass (pass 4) back to the green player who goes down the ice and shoots (shot 2) in the other end. y Points:

items.title: 2 shot transition drive wide pass to trailer set up for point shot - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shot transition drive wide pass to trailer set up for point shot - 10 mins
items.description: Whistle generated. On the whistle. The D (red) skates forward up off the wall from the blue and pivots to backward and skates back over the blue line. F1 (green) times his start ensuring the Dman is skating backward. Comes out of the center face off circle with a puck and passes (pass 1) it to the the D. F2 (blue) goes directly to the wall just over the center red line on the same side and posts up (stationary) with their stick on the ice (showing their forehand) The D steps up (starts skating forward) and passes (pass 2) the puck to F2 (blue) at the boards. F1 (green) turns up ice after his/her initial pass (pass 1) with timing and support, skating through the neutral zone towards the boards and F2. F2 (blue) chips/passes (pass 3) the puck to F1 (green) who receives the pass while collecting speed through the neutral zone. F1 (green) gains the offensive zone and "drives wide" with the puck. F2 (blue) gains the zone (staying onside) with F1 and goes into the middle staying high as the trailer. F1 (green) passes (pass 4) the puck up high to F1 (blue) who takes a shot (shot 1) with both F1 and F2 going the net/goalie for a rebound and to set up a screen. The D (red) follows up on the play/drill and stops just inside the blue line (on the same side as the coach), receives a pass (pass 5) from the coach out of the corner and take a point shot (shot 2) F1 and F2 play/ battle the goalie if any possible rebound. y Points: D – Step up/ skate forward when passing to the post up. (F2) F1 – drive wide and ss high to the trailer. Both forward go to the blue paint/crease area to set the screens. D – w powerful point shots

items.title: 2 shot warm ups cross ice (screen/tip) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shot warm ups cross ice (screen/tip) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle 2 players from each line (diagonal) skate across the ice to receive a pass from the other side. Player 1 (red) receives a pass and skates all the way down and proceeds to shoot and stay in front to set a screen on the goalie. Player 2 (blue) receives a pass and skates around the center ice circle back into the same end they started from and shoots through the screen set up from player 1. Opposite diagonal lines alternate and go on each whistle. y Points: Ensure to rotate from player 1 to player 2 every other rep.

items.title: 2 shots full ice tip/screen use cones (follow routes) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shots full ice tip/screen use cones (follow routes) - 10 mins
items.description: y p y p y y p shots full ice tip/screen use cones (follow routes) - 10 mins On the whistle 2 players from each line leave without a puck. Player 1 (blue) skates around the cones and goes deep and wide to the wall/boards skating up ice ready to receive a pass. Player 2 Green follows player 1 (blue) around the first cone and receives a pass from the line and immediately passes it up to player 1 (blue) who goes in and shoots (shot 1) then sets a screen. Player 2 (green) skates through the neutral zone going around the cone heading back to the line they originally started from, receives a pass and skates back diagonally through the neutral zone around the cone in the far end, and shoots (shot 2) through the screen set up by player 1. y Points: whistle generated. Net presence. remember to switch sides

items.title: 2 shots set play (chip pass, tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2 shots set play (chip pass, tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle both lines go simultaneously into each end. Player 1 (green) leaves and goes to boards/wall at the blue line. Posts up (stationary). Player 2 (blue) with timing leaves building speed and passes (pass 1) to player 1. Supporting the pass, player 2 skates directly towards player 1 who chips or passes the puck back to player 2 (blue) who receives/retrieves and goes and shoots and sets a screen in front of the goalie. Then player one (green) with timing skates along the blue line and gets a pass (pass 2) from the line turns up ice and shoots (shot 2) through the screen set up by player 1. y Points: Timing. remember to switch sides!

items.title: 3 shot retrieval timing drill - 10 mins
items.description: y g shot retrieval timing drill - 10 mins On the whistle, both ends go simultaneously the D (red) skates out of the corner, around the face off dot, does a tight turn with puck and passes (pass 1) it to the forward (blue) coming in with timing from the far side point. The forward (blue) shoots (shot 1) then vacates to retrieve a puck located at the far blue line near the other end, skates in that end and shoots, (shot 2) then sets a screen in front of the goalie. With timing after the original pass the D (red) skates backwards into the neutral zone, pivots to forward, goes to retrieve a puck (at the far blue line) and shoots, (shot 3) through the screen, set up by the forward. y Points: Shot 1. Can be a one timer Shot 2. Shoot for for 2nd chance opportunities bounds) Shot 3. Low, from the point Timing + Retrievals Know which way the shooter oots! for proper pass execution. Remember to switch sides.

items.title: 3 shot timing set play routes - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shot timing set play routes - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, Player 1 (green) starts with a puck and skates behind the net, Player 2 (blue) starts without a puck and skates behind the net to receive a drop pass (pass 1) behind the net. Upon the drop pass, Player 3 (red) with timing skates toward the slot and receives a pass (pass 2) from player 2 (blue) and shoots (shot 1) then goes in front and sets a screen. Player 1 (green) continues around the face off dot (staying low) and receives a pass (pass 3) from the green player line and shoots (shot 2) through the screen, then goes in front and sets a screen as well. (2 players in front now) Player 2 (blue) continues around the face off circle (going higher into the slot) and receives a pass (pass 4) from the blue player line and shoots (shot 3) through the double screen. y Points: Timing and awareness. Player remember to rotate lines.

items.title: 3 shot timing multiple elements (PATIENCE) - 10 mins
items.description: Whistle generated, one end only. Player 1 (red) starts by skating along and just outside the blue line from the boards towards the middle. Player 1 receives a pass from player 2 (green) Then player 1 passes to player 3 (blue) who with timing started backwards down the boards, pivots to forward and receives the pass from player 1. Player 3 skates behind the net with the puck and passes it back to player 1 (red) who supported with a breakout simulation (complete wide 360° circle) Player 1 now passes to player 2 (green) who timed and gapped player 1. Player 2 (green) skates backward through the neutral zone allowing player 1 (red) to to cross in front of player 2 (green). Player 2 passes the puck back to player 1 (red) who goes in and shoots and stays in front of the net. After player 3 (blue) passes to player 1 (on the break out simulation) Player 3 with timing proceeds to skate up the dot line to the far blue line and turns toward the boards. Player 3 receives a pass from center ice (the green line) and goes in and shoots (shot #2) and stays in front. Player 2 (green) with timing, allowing for the first 2 shots to take place, skates wide around the line and receives a pass (from center ice green line) and goes in and shoots (shot 3) through a double screen.

items.title: 3 shot timing, D retrieval (point shot) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shot timing, D retrieval (point shot) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the D's (red) skate over the blue line then pivots to backward and re- pivots to forward and retrieves a puck twice and makes 2 passes. Pass 1 is to F1 (blue) coming straight up the wall (along the boards) positions to post up (stationary) just below the center red line.
