F1 ( blue) receives the pass (pass 1) skates back in shoots (shot 1) and sets a screen in front of the goalie. Pass 2 from the D (red) is to F2 (green) who with timing does a deep neutral zone swing, receives the pass (pass 2) from the D (red) goes down and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen in front of the goalie (2 players there now F1 & F2) The D (red) follows up ice and receives a pass (pass 3) from coach and takes point shot (shot 3) with F1 + F2 infront. y Points: F1 and F2 time the D's retrievals and set sticks on the ice for the pass from the D, look up for pass readiness + awareness Remember to switch sides.

items.title: 3 shot warm ups D-motion passers (tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shot warm ups D-motion passers (tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle both ends start simultaneously. The D's (red) start skating forward from the center ice circle (to their right facing the offensive zone) and pivot to backward then receive a pass (pass 1) from the forward, F1 (blue) who with timing, skates with a puck out of the offensive zone. The D (red) passes (pass 2) the puck right back to F1 (blue) then goes in and shoots (shot 1) and sets a screen in front of the goalie. The D (red) then proceeds across the ice around the center face off circle and repeats the action on the other side with F2 (green) F2 (green) with timing passes (pass 3) the puck to the D, gets it right back (pass 4) then goes in and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen in front of the goalie as well (F1 and F2 now in front). The D (red) now skates back again over to the other side (where started from) just crosses the blue line and receives a pass (pass 5) from the coach and takes a point shot (shot 3). y Points: Timing. Forwards should pass when the D's are skating backward!

items.title: 3 shot with touch passes, retrieval,point shot (tip/screen) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shot with touch passes, retrieval,point shot (tip/screen) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, 2 players start from each end skating out of the corner with a puck, 1 player skates backwards (red) and one player skates forwards (blue) face to face with a small gap. Passing a puck back and forth 3-4 times. Player 1 (blue) takes the puck on the last pass and goes over the face off circle and shoots (shot 1) Player 2 (red) opens up and skates down the ice to retrieve a puck at the top of the face of circle in the other end. Player 2 (red) turns towards the boards with the puck and skates back out into the neutral zone and passes (pass 2) the puck to player 1 (blue), who after the 1st shot goes wide to outside the blue line, receives pass 2 from player 2 (red) turning back into the same end, goes in and shoots (shot 2) then sets a screen in front of the goalie. Player 2 (red) follows up ice just over the blue line and receives a pass (pass 3) from the original line they started from, and takes a shot (shot 3) from the point. y Points: Timing and patience. Low shots from the point. Remember to switch sides!

items.title: 3 shots 3 depth retrievals for D point shot (tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shots 3 depth retrievals for D point shot (tip_screen) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle both ends start simultaneously. The D (red) starts from the center ice circle, skates forward to the blue line, pivots to backward (to look/shoulder check for the forward) for a few strides. Then re- pivots to forward and retrieve a puck from the corner (puck pile 1) and skates it into the middle, heading up ice then passes (pass 1) it to F1 (blue) who with timing, skates deep down into the middle turning to the boards. F1 (blue) receives the pass (pass 1) and goes back down and shoots (shot 1) and sets a screen in front of the goalie. The Same D (red) skates up to the blue line stops and repeats the retrieval with F2 (blue) by going to puck pile 2 at the half wall (boards). The D (red) passes (pass 2) the puck to F2 (blue) who goes down and shoots (shot 2) and sets a second screen. The D (red) repeats (same routing) another retrieval from puck pile 3 skates to the middle, up ice and passes (pass 3) the puck to F3 (blue), who goes down and shoots through the double screen. OPTION: As an option after thte 3rd pass the D can go back and retrieve a 4th puck, skate it down and shoot (shot 4) from the point through a triple (3) player screen. y Points: Remember to switch sides.

items.title: 3 shots D- neutral zone retrievals - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shots D- neutral zone retrievals - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle both side go simultaneously. The D's (red) start at the middle blue line, skate forward to loose puck pile at center ice, retrieve a puck and skate backwards with it back to the blue line, then pass it (1st pass) to the forward (blue) on the right side. The forward skates back into the initial zone, shoots (shot 1) and sets a screen. The D (red) repeats the same route retrieving a puck skating backwards to the blue line making a 2nd pass to the forward (blue) on their left side. F2 skate back into the initial zone and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen. (2 forwards now in front of the goalie) The D (red) repeats the route, retrieve a 3rd puck and take into the zone and shoot (long shot #3) from just under the blue line. y Points: D, always pass to the right 1st, then to the left 2nd. F, post up at the center ice ards with stick on the ice and receive the pass on the forehand.

items.title: 3 shots from the point (screen_tips) - 10 mins
items.description: p shots from the point (screen_tips) - 10 mins On the whistle, A forward (blue) skates out of the corner with a puck and passes (pass 1) to the same side D (red) then get to the front of the net and set a screen for the shot (shot 1) coming from that D. After the 1st and a short net front battle with the goalie, the same forward goes into the other corner to retrieve a puck, skate out of the corner and passes (pass 2) to that same side D, then get back in front of the net and set a screen for the shot (shot 2) coming from that D. after the 2nd shot and a short net front battle with the goalie, that same forward stays in front awaiting a 3rd shot from the middle D. With timing, a pass (pass 3) comes out from a predetermined corner for a 3rd point shot with the forward already setting a screen.

items.title: 3 shots warm-up retrieval and timing - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shots warm-up retrieval and timing - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, the forward (blue) and defense man leave at the same time. The forward carries a puck over top and around the face off circle and shoots (shot 1), then continues over to the other side under the face off circle, heading up the boards and posts up just above the hash marks. The defense man with timing, starts forward (on the whistle) from the middle of the blue line, pivots to backward then re- pivots to forward goes into the corner, retrieves a puck skating towards the middle and passes (pass 1) it to the forward on the boards (breakout simulation). The forward receives the pass and skates over the face off circle and takes another shot (shot 2) and stays in front and sets a screen. After the defense man gives the outlet pass he/she skates outside the blue line turning from the boards to the middle (around the neutral zone face off dot) comes in and receives a pass from the corner (where the forwards are) and shoots (shot 3) from the point through the screen. y Points: Timing. Stick on the ice. Remember to switch sides.

items.title: 3 shots with a retrieval and stretch pass (Timing) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shots with a retrieval and stretch pass (Timing) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, a Defense man skates backwards up the boards and receives a pass from the corner when he/she gets level with the top of the circle. After receiving the pass, open up and skate into the middle to take a point shot (low shot #1). After the point shot the defense man accelerates over the blue line pivoting to skate backwards through the neutral zone, re pivots to forward, when crossing the other end blue line and proceeds into the corner to retrieve a loose puck, doing shoulder checks while heading into the corner. After the retrieval the Defense man continues up the same side boards, preparing to make a cross ice stretch pass to a Forward coming out of the far side end. After the initial point shot, a forward heads up the same side boards and cuts into the middle and receives a pass from the same corner, then takes a quick release shot (shot #2). After shot 2 the forward skates across to the other side going under the face off circle, heading up the boards, proceeds to outside the blue line skating toward the middle, receives a transition stretch pass from the original Defense man they started the drill with and goes in on net takes shot #3. y Points: This is a whistle generated drill. Remember to be patient. TIMING is critical!

items.title: 3 shots with retrievals (coaches pass) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the forward (blue) passes (pass 1) to the D (red) then goes directly to net and sets a screen. The D (red) receives the pass skates along the blue line (towards the middle) and shoots (shot 1) through the screen. After the point shot, the D skates over to the other side and retrieves a puck from the coach, then skates it into the neutral zone and passes (pass 2) to the F from the other end. At the same time the F (after the point shot) retreats to neutral and receives a pass (pass 2) from other D (coming out of the other end) transitions back in and shoots (shot 2) then sets another screen After that neutral zone pass the D-Follows to the other end to side the coach is located on, receives a pass from the coach and shoots (shot 3, point shot) through the screen. y Points: Timing! Impair the goalies vision. Low point shots. Remember to switch sides.

items.title: 3 shots with retrievals timing and tip/screens - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 shots with retrievals timing and tip/screens - 10 mins
items.description: y g p g p shots with retrievals timing and tip/screens - 10 mins On the whistle, the D (red) starts with a puck, takes a stride up the boards and passes (pass 1) it to the F (blue) who waits for the D to pivot to backwards, then passes (pass 2) it back to the D who touch passes (pass 3) back to the F. The F goes in and takes a shot (shot 1) after the shot the F vacates across the ice and back into the neutral zone. While the D after pass 3, goes in to retrieve a puck, (loose puck in the corner) skates it out to the blue line towards the middle, and gives the F a stretch pass (pass 4) who goes back in and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen. After pass 4, the D follows up, skates around the center ice circle, sets up at the point, (same side as the coach) receives pass from coach and shoots (shot 3) through the screen.

items.title: 3 shots, screen/tips 3 D-retrievals - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, the D skates forward to the top of the circle and pivots to backward towards the middle. Then re- pivots to forward, retrieves a puck from the corner and skates with it to the hash marks preparing to make a pass (The D does this action 3 times... 2 passes and then takes a point shot). The first forward, (blue) approaches from the far side boards center red line, swinging low in support of the D's first pass. That forward (blue) receives the 1st pass and goes down the ice and shoots (shot 1) and stays in front of the goalie to set a screen. The 2nd forward (green) comes straight down the boards, posts up and receives the 2nd pass from the D then goes down and shoots (shot 2) and sets a 2nd screen. The D (red) does a 3rd retrieval and carries the puck down the ice and takes the point shot (shot 3) through the double screen. y Points: D, always do shoulder checks. F's remember to set screens, but has the ability to and deflect the shots. All shots are hard and low!

items.title: 4 shots, D-retrievals (F's find seams and transiton) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 4 shots, D-retrievals (F's find seams and transiton) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, the D starts in the corner and skates over top the face off circle facing up ice, then pivots to retrieve a spotted puck, 4 times. After retrieving, the D makes 3 passes, one at a time to each open forward. (the Forwards try to find and get into an open lane) The D (red) finds and passes (pass 1) to one of the open forwards. (The D can pass to any of the forwards, in this diagram the green forward gets the first pass) The forwards then go in and shoot and set a screen. The Forwards who do not get a pass must go back and tag the blue line, re-find/locate open lanes and regroup back to the D (to get their pass) if a pass is not received. (In this diagram the 2nd pass goes to the yellow forward) The yellow forward goes back in and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen. This means the blue forward must re-tag the blue line find a lane to receive a pass (pass 3) from the D and goes in to shoot (shot 3) and sets a screen (3 forwards in front now) The D does a 4th retrieval then carries the puck all the down and takes a point shot (shot 4) through a triple screen. The forwards battle the goalie if there is a rebound. y Points: F's fill lanes and stay in lanes. F's go north south (tight turns when transitioning) s read and pass to the nearest and most open forward. F's must be facing the D to receive pass. Coaches can fill lanes with active sticks, making the forwards find openings.

items.title: Cross ice drop pass, neutral zone transition,point shot to a 3vs2 - 10 mins
items.teaser: Cross ice drop pass, neutral zone transition,point shot to a 3vs2 - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, the green and blue forwards skate toward each other (the blue forward has the puck) the blue forward passes (pass 1) the puck to the green forward. Still skating toward each other the green forward executes a drop pass (pass 2) back to blue forward who turns up ice with the puck. On the initial whistle, with timing a D (red) pairing skate backward through the neutral zone (towards their own end) The Blue forward passes (pass 3) the puck to the nearest D, who do a D-D Pass (pass 4). The blue and green forwards now can swing or stop transition, receive a pass (pass 5) back from the D and go back in on a 2vs0 passing the puck, take a shot, then both stay in front to set a double screen. The D move up to the blue line, receive a pass (pass 8) from the corner where the forwards (yellow) are located. Do a D-D pass (pass 9) and take a point shot (shot 3) through the double screen. (battle the goalie if there's a rebound) After the point shot, a 3rd forward (yellow) skates out of the corner with a puck to join the other 2 forwards (blue and green) and attack the 2 D (red) executing a 3vs2 going down to the other end. y Points: Timing. Screen positioning. Low point shots. Triangular attack on the 3VS2.

items.title: Multiple elements timing and positioning - 10 mins
items.teaser: Multiple elements timing and positioning - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, D1 (red) starts backwards along the boards and does a one touch pass exchange with D2. D2 soft dumps the puck into the same side corner for D1 to retrieve. At the same time F1 (blue) leaves and skates along the blue line into the middle and receives a pass (pass 1) from F2 (green) F1 goes in and takes a shot (shot 1). With timing D1 retrieves the puck and skates it behind the net over to the other side, After F1 shoots, go deep into the corner heading up ice simulating a break out and receives a pass (pass 2) from D1. F2 (green) after the whistle to start the drill, with timing skates to the middle into the zone supporting F1 on the same side and receives a pass (pass 3) and skates the puck out of the zone. 2 Defencemen awaiting and are gaping through the neutral zone and receive a pass (pass 4) from F2 (green) they pass (pass 5) D-D F1 and F2 on the way out of the zone receive a pass (pass 6) back from the D's and turn back and attack against the original D who retrieved the puck (gaping the forwards) and a new D who with timing, steps in off the boards to join the drill making it a 2 vs 2. After the sequence and a short battle, clear the zone, then the other side goes. y Points: Timing. Accurate passing. Forwards should try to stay inside the dot line.

items.title: Multiple elements with a back check - 10 mins
items.teaser: Multiple elements with a back check - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle from the center ice boards a coach dumps a puck into the opposite corner. Starting in the middle at the blue line a D (red) goes in to retrieve the puck and passes (pass 1) it to forward (blue) who from the same side as the retrieval with timing posts up at the hash marks ready for the breakout pass. The opposite side forward with timing, skates across the ice swinging low with support and receives a pass (pass 2) from the posted up forward. Both forwards skate out of the zone (one with the puck) into the neutral zone and pass (pass 3) the puck to a 3rd forward waiting in middle at the far blue line. The defense man (after the breakout pass) tracks and gaps the 2 forwards, follows them up ice ready to defend the 2 vs 1. As soon as the 3rd forward receives the pass, the 2 initial forwards transition back the other way. The 3rd forward passes (pass 4) the puck back to one of them, then they attack the D on a 2 vs 1. The 3rd forward joins in the drill (back checking) immediately after passing the puck back to the forwards progressing the drill from a 2 vs 1 rush into a 2 vs 2 in the zone. y Points: One end at a time alternating back and forth. Quick transitions. D's track and p after the first pass. The 3rd forward is a defensive player (helping the D) when joining e drill. Forwards remember to alternate.

items.title: Multiple game situated team elements (back checking and shots) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Multiple game situated team elements (back checking and shots) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, D1 skates in and immediately passes (pass 1) to D2 who skates into the slot and takes a shot (shot 1) After the shot D2 skates backwards ready to take on a 2 vs 1. D1 after the first pass, skates across and behind the net to retrieve a puck and pass (pass 2) to the forward (green) in the middle who with the other forward (blue) left on the initial whistle with timing. The green forward now passes (pass 3) the puck up to the blue forward located at the boards on the blue line. They attack against D2 (red) in a 2 vs 1 (making pass 4) into the other end, with D1 following up gaping ready to take on a 3 vs 1 back into the same end they started from. On a whistle (2nd whistle) the yellow forward joins the drill with a puck. The 2 forwards (blue and green) transition back with the yellow forward attacking D1 on a 3 vs 1 (making passes 5 and 6) On the second whistle D2 (who faced the 2 vs 1) NOW becomes a back checker, picks up/covers the nearest open forward. Now making the drill a 3 vs 2. Battle for 15 to 20 seconds until a whistle or a goal! y Points: Forwards timing and position. Defencemen gap control with active sticks.

items.title: Multiple shots (X3) and elements with a single cycle simulation to point shot - 10 mins
items.teaser: Multiple shots (X3) and elements with a single cycle simulation to point shot - 10 mins
items.description: ns On the whistle a forward comes out of the corner across the front of the net and receives a pass (pass 1) from the D in the opposite corner. The forward goes down the ice along the dot line to the other end and takes a shot (shot 1) Then the forward heads to the other end opposite corner and receives a pass (pass 2) from a defenceman in that line. The forward carries that puck to the Hash on the wall and gives a cycle drop pass off the wall back to the D (stepping up in support). The forward continues to skate over top of the face off circle and gets the puck back (pass 3) in the middle and shoots (shot 2) After the 2nd shot the forward goes in front and sets a screen ready for a point shot. After the 3rd pass the defenceman skates around the face off circle (always facing up ice/pivoting) heading straight up the boards and stops at the point (blue line) in the other end. The defenceman receives a pass (pass 4) from one of the forwards in the same side corner, drags or goes to the dots for a point shot (shot 3) y Points: Timing. Accurate passes. Remember to switch sides.

items.title: Multiple shots and elements - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the forwards (blue) leaves with a puck and skates towards the D (red) Letting the D come up and then pivot to backwards. The forward passes (pass 1) to the D (ensuring the D is skating backwards with his/her stick on the ice) The D immediately touch passes (pass 2) the puck back to the forward who goes in and shoots (shot 1) Right after the shot the forward circles to the boards, skates up and out into the neutral zone, while the D retreats deep across into the corner to retrieve a spotted/loose puck and skates with it straight up and outside the zone. The D (red) passes (pass 3) the puck to the forward into the neutral zone who turns up ice, goes in a and shoots (shot 2) then sets a screen in front of the goalie awaiting a point shot. After the 3rd pass the Defenceman follows up to the middle of the blue line, stops, receives a pass from the coach in the corner and shoots (shot 3) through the screen. y Points: Both ends go simultaneously. Timing. Accurate passes. Remember to switch es

items.title: Multiple shots with timing (individual skills) - 10 mins
items.teaser: Multiple shots with timing (individual skills) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, both ends all 4 players start simultaneously. The blue players start forward from the blue line, turn to backwards skate to the center red line then re-pivot to forward. Receive a pass (pass 1) from the same line they started from, go in and shoot (shot 1, from the slot) Meanwhile on the same whistle the green players skates with a puck, weaving through pre-set cones (pylons) taking a low/close shot (shot 2) After shot 2 (green player) positions into the slot. The blue player after shot 1 goes into the same side corner to retrieve a loose puck, comes up and out of the corner and passes (pass 2) it to the green player positioned in front for shot 3. y Points: Timing and positioning. Remember to switch sides and the players should ernate lines.

items.title: 3 player transition simulation advance the puck - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3 player transition simulation advance the puck - 10 mins
items.description: player transition simulation advance the puck - 10 mins 2 quick passes through neutral zone, pass to the coach and transition back 3 vs 0. y Points: Advance puck through the lanes. Stay in the lanes even in transition. Upon entry, t up triangular attack. Minimize the passes when entering the zone. Get the puck to the t and swarm the blue paint. Player remember to alternate lines.

items.title: 3vs0 End to end warm ups with a point shot - 10 mins
items.teaser: 3vs0 End to end warm ups with a point shot - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the RW (right winger,blue) starts with a puck and passes it to the D (red) The D passes it right back to the RW and he/she passes it right back to the D (3 passes). Then the RW (blue) swings low and skates up the boards.(far side lane) With timing the C (center man, green) follows behind the RW and does a pass exchange (2 more passes) with the D as well. Then turns up the middle lane. Also with timing, the LW (yellow) waits for the pass completions and starts skating up the boards in their lane. The D (red) now with the puck, steps up and passes (pass 6) the puck to the LW (yellow) who advances/passes (pass 7) it immediately up to the C (green, center man) The C (green) carries the puck (driving wide and deep) over the blue line and can exercise 3 options. 1. Pass to the LW (yellow) driving the net 2. Pass to the RW (blue) in the high slot OR 3. Shoot! After the shot (shot 1) all the forwards position in front and set screens. The D (red) follows up the the blue line, stops, receives a pass from the coach (stationed in the corner) and shoots (shot 2) through the screen. y Points: Once over the blue line there is a 1 pass maximum rule then shoot immediately d swarm the blue paint, set up screen positions with the ability to tip/deflect. Alternate ds after each rep. Remember to switch sides.

items.title: Long pass single shot warm up with timing and rotation - 10 mins
items.teaser: Long pass single shot warm up with timing and rotation - 10 mins
items.description: Both sides start simultaneously on the whistle. The player passes the puck down and across the ice to the player at the hash marks on the wall. Continues to skate under and across the blue line proceeding around the other side face off dot back into the middle. The initial pass gets passed all the back to the starting position where the next player in line re- passes the puck to the original player coming into the middle. The initial player receives the pass and goes down the middle to shoot. After the shot the player rotates to the bottom line near the hash marks on the wall. The Player stationed at the hash mark makes their pass and proceeds straight up the wall to join the line at the far blue line to complete the rotation. y Points: Remember to switch sides.

items.title: Neutral zone warm up with pivots, D-D and transition simulation - 10 mins
items.teaser: Neutral zone warm up with pivots, D-D and transition simulation - 10 mins
items.description: y utral zone warm up with pivots, D-D and transition simulation - 10 mins On the whistle, opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 starts without a puck and receives a pass (pass 1) from the line in front if them, skates with it towards the middle and passes it (pass 2) across the ice to the front player in that line. Player 1 then proceeds to pivot and skate around the center ice face off circle (always facing the puck) Pass 3 is a D-D simulation. Player 1 then re-pivots to forward and receives pass 4 and goes in and shoots! On the next whistle the other players go the other way! y Points: Hard passes, tape to tape! Always face the puck. Stay outside of the center ice cle. Timing and control speed.

items.title: Offensive zone shooting drill with timing - 10 mins
items.teaser: Offensive zone shooting drill with timing - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, the blue player starts without a puck, skates towards the middle over the cone and receives a pass (pass 1) from the green player on the other side. Right after the pass the green player now skates towards the middle over the cone and heads to the net, while the blue player goes down and around the second cone and passes (pass 2) it back to the green player who goes in and shoots (shot 1) After the 2nd pass, the blue player continues back over the cone towards the line where they came from. Turning down around the middle cone (going towards the net) the blue player receives a pass (pass 3) from the line and goes in and shoots (shot 2) y Points: Timing. Remember to alternate lines.

items.title: shooting position specific timing with progressions - 10 mins
items.teaser: shooting position specific timing with progressions - 10 mins
items.description: A-(Part 1) On the whistle. The forward (blue) goes into the corner, retrieves a puck skates up the boards and passes (pass 1) it to the 'D' (red) continue up the wall and receives the puck back (pass 2) then walks off the wall over circle goes in and shoots. Alternate sides on each whistle. B-(Part 2) On the whistle. The forward goes into the corner and retrieves a puck skates up the boards with it and passes (pass 1) it to the 'D' The D then passes (pass 2) it 'D'-'D' to their partner along the blue line. The forward follows in support along the blue line and receives the puck (pass 3) back and turns down, goes in and shoots. After the shot, the defense men slide/shift across the blue line (re-position) to do the other side. C-(Part 3) On the whistle. The forward goes into the corner and retrieves a puck, skates up the boards with it and passes (pass 1) to the 'D'. The immediately goes in front of the net to set a screen. The 'D' then passes (pass 2) it D-D to their partner along the blue line who takes a shot through the screen. After the shot, the defense men slide/shift across the blue line (re-position) to do the other side. y Points: Alternate from side to side on the whistle and players remember to switch sides.

items.title: Touch passes, Drive wide, Trailer pass - 10 mins
items.teaser: Touch passes, Drive wide, Trailer pass - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle. F (blue) and D (red) start face to face... The F skates backward, the D skates forward up the boards maintaining a small consistent gap, while making 2-3 touch passes. The F opens up and skates across just above the blue line to receive a pass from the D coming out of the other end with a puck. The F receives the pass, enters the zone, driving wide and deep and returns a trailer pass to the D following the play. The F goes to the front of the net to screen/tip or deflect the D's shot. y Points: Remember to switch sides.

items.title: 2vs0 with a puck exchange and 2 drop passes - 10 mins
items.teaser: 2vs0 with a puck exchange and 2 drop passes - 10 mins
items.description: y s0 with a puck exchange and 2 drop passes - 10 mins On the whistle both ends go simultaneously in pairs. The players skate down the boards one with a puck (red) and one player without a puck (blue) to the hash marks then turning in towards the middle, execute a drop pass (pass 1) in front of the net (or Behind the net). Now both players skate back towards the boards wide and head up ice (blue player now with the puck) then pass (pass 2, exchange) the puck just before reaching the blue line through the neutral zone to the players coming out of the other end. Staying wide, after receiving the pass (pass2) through the neutral zone the players skate towards the middle and make another drop pass (pass 3) at center ice area. Then the players turn back in and attack 2 vs 0. (can make another pass 4 when entering the zone). y Points: Keep a consistent gap with timing.

items.title: 1vs0 to 1vs1 progressive warm ups (neutral zone) - 10 mins
items.teaser: 1vs0 to 1vs1 progressive warm ups (neutral zone) - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle. A-Part 1 The forward (blue) leaves the line backwards and receives a pass (pass 1 from the line), opens up and skates across the ice with the puck then passes (pass 2) it to a player at the front in the other side line, turn up ice for the return pass (pass 3) completing a give and go. Then proceed down the ice and take a shot. B-Part 2 Same as part 1, progressing to the D (red) engaging (with timing and gap control) off the wall at center ice to face and defend the attacking F (blue) in a 1 vs 1. y Points: Controlled Backward start. Stick on the ice. D timing and gap control. Alternate d switch sides.

items.title: 1vs1 basic D-gap drill using cones - 10 mins
items.teaser: 1vs1 basic D-gap drill using cones - 10 mins
items.description: s1 basic D-gap drill using cones - 10 mins On the whistle. The offensive player (blue) skates up the boards with a puck, does a tight turn around the 2nd (furthest) cone and attacks 1 vs 1. The defensive player (red) tracks and gaps the offensive player, then pivots to backwards around 1st (closest) cone and defends the 1 vs 1. y Points: All players can take a turn at playing defense (red) Offensive players should ve the net directly with speed. Defensive players should try to apply tracking and gaping. member to switch sides.

items.title: 1vs1 D set up - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle both ends go simultaneously. The D (red) and the F (blue) skate into the neutral zone, the D with a puck. (staying outside of the center ice circle) passes (pass 1) it to the D (red) in the other end. The F (blue) stays wide, then skates into the middle (just above the face off circles) and receives a pass (pass 2) from the D in the other end. The F (blue) now with the puck stays wide and turns up the ice (back towards the original end started from) to attack the D (red) 1 vs 1, who has been tracking and gaping the forward the whole time. y Points: D remember to stay out of the center ice circle. Select a good pivot point when cking and gaping. F – Support and swing low when receiving the pass to attack the 1 vs 1. ack with speed and drive the net. Remember to switch sides.

items.description: p s1 D-D gap (forward support the puck) - 10 mins On the whistle. The F (blue) start with a puck pass (pass 1) to the D's (red) who start at the blue line and skate backwards to maintain a gap on the forwards. The D's (red) do a D – D pass (pass 2) then pass (pass 3) it back to the forward (red) who is swing low in support. The D who received the 1st initial pass, steps/skates back up to the center red line to re-establish a good gap to face the on- coming forward in a 1 vs 1. y Points: F – Swing low to support the puck after pass to D. Stay behind the puck during e D, D pass. Sticks on the ice. D's – heads up awareness to re, establish maintain a good p. D's remember to rotate. Remember to switch sides

items.title: 1vs1 D-gap - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle, the forwards (blue) and the defense (red) start simultaneously from both ends. The forwards start without a puck by skating straight up the ice along the boards into the other end. Turning into the middle along the tops of the face off circles. Receive a pass (pass 1) from the forward line in the other end. Now with the puck turn up ice along the dot line to face and attack the D in a 1 vs 1. With timing the D (red) skates out of the corner and pivots (always facing up ice, tracking the on coming forward) around the same side face off circle heading up the boards. The D should get outside the blue line and start to set up and re-establish a good gap to defend the on coming forward in a 1 vs 1. y Points: D's should maintain and keep their Hips up, ice. Try to keep a consistent gap ontrol) F's should swing LOW and receive passes in stride. Attack with speed through the utral zone. Remember to switch sides.

items.title: 1vs1 D-spot the puck and gap recover - 10 mins
items.teaser: 1vs1 D-spot the puck and gap recover - 10 mins
items.description: s1 D-spot the puck and gap recover - 10 mins On the whistle. With timing the F's (blue) take 1 or 2 strides and pass (pass 1) to the D's (red) while the D's are skating backwards starting from the center ice red line at the face off circle. The forwards continue to skate, swing low under the blue line Staying outside the face off dot line, ready to retrieve/pick up a puck placed on the red line on the other side and attack 1 vs 1. The forward gets puck (pass 2) from the coach and skates up the wall ready to be pinched/impacted/body checked. (shot 2) y Points: This is a sacrifice, timing and angle of pursuit drill for the defense. The forwards ed to accept that they will be hit and or pinched against the boards. Remember to switch es.

items.title: 1vs1 F-retrieve D-D (gapping) net drive - 10 mins
items.description: s1 F-retrieve D-D (gapping) net drive - 10 mins On the whistle both ends start simultaneously. The F's (blue) skate from the hash marks and retrieve a puck at the blue line then pass (pass 1) it to the D's (red). The D's pass (pass 2) it D-D. With the forward swinging just above the blue line, staying behind of and supporting the puck, receive pass (pass 3) back from the D, then turn up ice with the puck and attack 1 vs 1, go in and shoot (shot 1) and stays in front gaining position on the D awaiting a point shot. items.title: 1vs1 multiple passes and route specific - 10 mins
items.teaser: 1vs1 multiple passes and route specific - 10 mins
items.description: On the whistle the F and D start simultaneously. Both players start backwards straight up the boards and do a pass (passes 1 and 2) exchange with the line. Both players then re-pivot to forwards, skating across the ice directly towards the other line and do a pass (passes 3 and 4) exchange with that line. Both players continue skating forwards around and back towards the line they started from (staying outside the center face off circle) and do a pass (passes 5 and 6) exchange. items.title: 1vs1 progress to 2vs1 D-track and gap - 10 mins
items.teaser: 1vs1 progress to 2vs1 D-track and gap - 10 mins
items.description: Part A = 1 vs 1 On the whistle, both sides start simultaneously. The forward (green) starts with a puck, skates up through the neutral zone, carrying it around cone, heading back the other way (transitioning) allowing the defense man to track and gap, attacking the defense man. (1 vs 1) The defense man starts/initiates to track and gap the forward once he/she passes by them, crossing over the center ice red line. Part B = 2 vs 1 The same as part A except the forward passes (pass 1) the puck to first forward in the other forward line once they go past the cone. Skating wide turning up ice, receives the pass (pass 2) back, now attacking the gaping D 2 vs 1. y Points: D's Timing, tracking and gaping. F's, 1 vs 1 net drive. 2 vs 1, drive wide, one ss maximum, shoot then go for rebounds.
