items.description: © Copyright HockeyCoach.com Vision Hockey LLC Forwards start on the goal line. Defensive players start on the dot. Forward starts with the puck and skates 1 vs 1 with the defensive player. Forward is not allowed to go outside of dots. Defensive player is not allowed to turn forwards. Not allow the player to turn forward helps your defensive player build up speed while skating backwards. Strong players will even turn forward during the drill if you let them. This will help establish confidence with your defensive core. Defensive player will attempt to angle forward player to the wall and out of the scoring area

items.title: Drill #15 2 vs 1 Regroup
items.description: © Copyright HockeyCoach.com Vision Hockey LLC Continuous / Flow 2 vs 1 Drill - no whistles. D1 starts the drill by going to receive a pass from coach. F1 players are not activated until t coach passes the puck to D1. Once the pass is completed to D1, forward players criss-cross in front of D1 and open up. D passes to either forward. F1 makes one simple pass to his partner and passes to D2. F1 players criss-cross again in front of D2, opening up to the puck. D2 passes the puck up to the F1 players heading up ice. After F1 players receive the pass from D2, they go down 2 vs 1. Once the regroup is completed by D2 D2 skates towards the coach on their side and

items.title: Drill #16 2 vs 1 Center Ice
items.description: Both lines go F1 and F2. 4 forward players in motion at all times. Each forward line will star with a puck. Example will be shown from F1 line. One F1 player will start with a puck and pass to D1. Bo F1's hook to the right and open up a pass from D1. F1 receives a pass from D1 and pass the puck to D2. F1's open up and receive a pass back from D2. F1's play the 2 vs 1 against D1.

items.title: Drill #17 Los Angeles 2 vs 1
items.description: © Copyright HockeyCoach.com Vision Hockey LLC Both sides go at the same time. F1 begins with the puck and passes to D1 player skating backwards. F1 opens up to the wall and receives a pass back from D1. F1 passes to F2 and hooks to the middle of the ice. F2 receives the pass and jumps up in the play with F1 playing in a 2 vs 1 against D1.

items.title: Drill #18 2 vs 1 Center Ice
items.description: X3 begins the drill with a shot on net. X3 can pick if he wants to go to the X1 or X2 line In this example, X3 hooks around the cone and goes to the X1 line. X1 makes a pass t X3 and they go down the ice. The opposite line, in this example, X2 in red will now become the back checker. A defensive player jumps into the play as X3 decides on what line he is going to go to Players play a 2 vs 1 down with a back checker. Once the play is completed. The back checker X2 will restart the drill in the opposite e

items.title: Drill #19 Hynes 2 vs 1 Backcheck
items.description: © Copyright HockeyCoach.com Vision Hockey LLC y p y Once the play is completed. The back checker X2 will restart the drill in the opposite e of the ice. He can select X1 or X2. The side he doesn't go to will become the back F1 on the wall always starts with the puck. F3 is on their stomach and is a backchecker. They are on the lower line of the circle. O the whistle, F1 and F2 go down the ice against D1. F3 trys to catch up to force a

items.title: Drill #20 2 vs 0, 2 vs 1, 3 vs 2
items.description: © Copyright HockeyCoach.com Vision Hockey LLC Structure 2 vs 0, 2 vs 1, 3 vs 2. F1 and F2 start behind the blue line, and on the whistle crash the net. Coach passes a puck o for a quick play. After the first shot is completed, players come to a full stop. D1 goes out to the middle of the ice, and F1 and F2 begin to go towards the opposite end. Coach passes a puck to F1 or F2, and players go down 2 vs 1 with D1. Once the 2 vs 1 is completed, F3 skates out with a puck. D2 pops out into the middle of the i F1 and F2 come up into the rush with F3. D1 rushes to get back to join in for a 3 vs 2.

items.title: D WIDE ENTRY CATCH & QUICK RELEASE
items.teaser: D WIDE ENTRY CATCH & QUICK RELEASE
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Get as square to net • Hands out in front, top hand elbow out for better pass reception • Quick release • Fake shot quick release • 1 timer DESCRIPTION 1. D starts on dot in NZ, backwards to red and then forward to blue line, enter outside dots 2. passes to D to simulate 4th man on rush 3. D catch & release with toes & hips at net as you approach dot line 4. D if on off wing can work on 1 timer or fake shot gain inside dots quick release Simple drill... effective added offence Variation, D could enter strong side, or 2nd puck on a rim, or drive backdoor. 05 | WARM-UPS 6

items.title: D OZ RIMS FOR ATTACKS
items.description: 7 KEY POINTS: • catch puck, separate from boards in case D needs to protect puck or cut back DESCRIPTION 1. rims puck, D 1 dives down, in area Option A) shoot on net or for tips, if carried to area Option B) keep puck, keep moving, look for F to pop out for pass

items.title: D 3 PUCKS OZ OPTIONS
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Change angle • Quick release • Quick hands in tight DESCRIPTION 1. D3 low to high direct to D1 step outside & quick release 2. D1 half dive to criss cross with D2, D3 to D2 to D1 for 1 timer 3. D1 dive down 2nd post, D3 direct pass or shoot for 2nd pad 05 | WARM-UPS 8

items.title: D ATTACKS 4 PUCK DRILLS
items.description: 9 KEY POINTS: • Changing points of attack • At the point if 1 timer isn’t right don’t force it, catch & releae in motion • Allow Ds to be scoring threats & comfortable with pucks below tops of circle DESCRIPTION D1 & D3 work together, D2 & D4 work together, and switch after each sequence 1. D3 indirect to D1 for 1 timer 2. D1 “Dive” inside dots, D3 pass from corner or skates up wall to- wards hash marks pass to D1, on & off stick, D1 stay at net for tips 3. D4 pass to D2 for low to high direct pass 1 timer 4. D 4 then up towards blue leaving outside lane for D2 & drop pass “High Cycle”

items.title: SWEDEN WIDTH & DEPTH D SHOOTING DRILL
items.teaser: SWEDEN WIDTH & DEPTH D SHOOTING DRILL
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Don’t force bad shot • Be ready to use depth or width, be assertive in decision • Shoot to score & tips inside dots • Shoot for tips outside dots or shoot to create chaos for goalie DESCRIPTION You can use F’s & D’s at both ends or in stations, or even just use the D including for net presence. • OPTION 1: D3 indirect to D1,1 timer • OPTION 2: D3 indirect or direct to D1 --> D2 shot & go for D Dive inside shoulder of coach, D1 stay at net • OPTION 3: D4 indirect to D2 -->D1, D1 --> D3 who comes up the boards, play give • OPTION 4: D4 skates up wall, D2 slide blue for 1 timer or high cycle shoot from funnel area, outside dots 05 | WARM-UPS 10

items.title: CORNER TO CORNER
items.description: DESCRIPTION 1. F1 moves puck behind net,F2 leaves without puck 2. F2 moves toward puck, protects stick and attacks net with 3 options Option 1: Quick jam Option 2: Walk north of goal-line Option 3: Attack far post 05 | WARM-UPS 14

items.title: CORNER TO NET FRONT
items.description: 15 DESCRIPTION 1. F 1 rims puck beind net,F2 starts net front 2. F2 rolls with puck behind net, protects stick and attacks net with 3 options Option 1: Quick jam Option 2: Walk north of goal-line Option 3: Attack far post

items.title: 2 MAN CYCLE
items.description: DESCRIPTION 1. F1 leaves with puck and cycles back to F2 2. F2 returns pass to F1 for shot 3. F1 retrieves puck behind net and finds F2 for shot 4. F2 receives puck from F3 and drill becomes continuous Options: behind net or against the grain 05 | WARM-UPS 16

items.title: HIGH ROLL
items.description: 17 DESCRIPTION 1. F moves puck low to high to D, F follows pass 2. D walks to middle and finds F for high roll 3. F walks up wall and attacks net 4. F retrieves puck behind net and finds D in middle, weakside or strongside

items.title: RED WING CYCLE
items.description: DESCRIPTION 1. D rims puck 2. Netfront F1 rolls with pick and finds F2 jumping off wall for a shot 3. F2 retrieves puck and moves puck to D 4. D shoots through layered hi-lo screen 05 | WARM-UPS 18

items.title: 2 ON 0 ZONE ENTRY
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Skate hard in NZ without going offside • Hard pass in OZ • Drive the net DESCRIPTION 1. F1 and F2 leave at same time 2. F1 skates with puck and makes a quick pass before the blue line to F2, and drives hard to the net 3. F2 has 3 options: - shoot to score - shoot off pads for rebound - pass to F1 for a shot 4. F2 can also cut back across blueline 05 | WARM-UPS 22

items.title: 3 ON 0 ZONE ENTRY
items.description: 23 KEY POINTS: • Drive the net hard • Kicking pass off right before blueline without going offside DESCRIPTION 1. F1 carries puck to far blue line and kicks it out to one side, continues to drive to the net F2 has three options: - Shot/Pass off pads - Hit F 1 - Hit F3 in the far dot lane

items.title: 3 ON 0 ZONE ENTRY WITH D
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Drive the net hard • Kicking pass off right before blueline without going offside DESCRIPTION 1. F1 carries puck to far blue line and kicks it out to one side, continues to drive to the net 2. F2 has three options: - Shot/Pass off pads - Hit F1 - Hit F3 in the far dot lane 3. D1 joins rush as 4th man and become another option for F2 05 | WARM-UPS 24

items.title: 3 ON 0 ZONE ENTRY WITH BACK CHECK
items.teaser: 3 ON 0 ZONE ENTRY WITH BACK CHECK
items.description: 25 KEY POINTS: • Drive the net hard • Kicking pass off right before blueline without going offside DESCRIPTION 1. F1 carries puck to far blue line and kicks it out to one side, continues to drive to the net 2. F2 has three options: - Shot/Pass off pads - Hit F1 - Hit F 3 in the far dot lane 3. Add X as a back checker who the coach releases at differnt times (early/late) and from either side 4. Then add in 2 F +X so it is a 3 vs 2 with back check

items.title: 3 ON 0 ZONE ENTRY WITH D
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Focus on driving off back foot leading into pivot • Stick placement following behind body to cut off open ice DESCRIPTION 1. Progression: - Pivots Right - Pivots Left - Both Sides 05 | WARM-UPS 28

items.title: BACK TO CIRCLE PIVOT DRILL
items.description: 29 KEY POINTS: • Bend knee, don’t stand straight up. DESCRIPTION 1. Focusing on breaking down transitioning for- ward. Trying to elimate crossovers and keeping hips open. Helps with mobility. 2. Drill to be done at 25% speed 3. Always skating forwards. 4. Always turn your back to pylon. 5. Loadup on outside skate and inside skate tuck in before exploding to inside skate. 6. Example. First Pylon aproach turning your back to pylon, loadup on left skate tucking in right skate. Really slow it down and explode with left skate transferring weight to extended right skate on ice. Continue to next pylon reversing the other way.

items.title: BACKWARDS, PIVOT, ATTACK AND REPEAT
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Stay balanced. • No Crossovers, Use T-Push DESCRIPTION 1. C-Cut, C-Cut 2. Pivot with the stick following behind (Herding) 3. Stick touch boards and transition backwards using your skate to turn you around. NO Stopping 4. Lateral pushes to get you back to the dots 5. Repeat 05 | WARM-UPS 30

items.title: ANGLE PROGRESSION
items.description: 31 KEY POINTS: • Wide angle, matching Forwards speed • Stick placement, taking away the middle of the ice until last second, then stick on puck DESCRIPTION *Start drill at half speed and progress to full 1. F drives along boards and takes the wide lane to the net 2. D takes wide angle and holds stick on the board side at all times, cutting off the middle lane 3. D goes stick on puck when the F has been completely closed off

items.title: FIGURE 8 GAP
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Gap control DESCRIPTION On whistle both sides go at the same time. Main purpose of this drill is gap control 1. On whistle F1 skates at 50% speed around the circles in a figure 8. 2. F1 goes forwards when F1 is going away from him and pivots backwards when he is coming towards him. 3. The distance between both skaters is called your gap. Try to maintain a 2-3 stick length gap in this drill 4. After you complete the figure 8 twice the players continue down the ice. F1 focus on going towards wing, laterally to make D1 have to adjust. 05 | WARM-UPS 32

items.title: 2V1 RG 2V1
items.description: KEY POINTS: • D- Active feet, head up to pass • F- fast attack, quick on the regroup DESCRIPTION Whistle Starts Drill End 1 • Two F’s start from corner and attack net 2v1 End 2 • D evasive moves mirrored by C • After 2 F’s attack net, they regroup with far side with D2 and they attack back against original D • Next repitition begins at End 2 05 | WARM-UPS 34

items.title: 3-MAN HORSESHOE
items.description: 35 KEY POINTS: • Follows 1-man and 2-man horseshoe as a progression • Support, weaving and moving as a unitk DESCRIPTION • X and O leave their ends without a puck • Players turn at pylon and receive a pass from the corner, takes puck to • the wall, while the passer takes the middle ice • X2 and O2 takes off in support • 1st player drifts to middle and passes to trailer • Trailer goes hard and wide, passes to 1st player in the slot for a shot • Trailer becomes 1st player and the drill be- comes continous

items.title: 3-SHOT WARM UP
items.description: KEY POINTS: • hard passes • look for tip/screen on shots DESCRIPTION • F1 and D play catch as D backs up to blueline. D pivots and opens up • F1 skates towards the net, receives a pass from and takes a shot (SHOT 1) • D makes a stretch pass to the opposite F2, who goes in for a shot on the opposite net (SHOT 2) • D follows pass to hold blue line- as rings puck up boards • D walks out and shoots (SHOT 3) • F1 & F2 hold net for a hi-lo screen 05 | WARM-UPS 36

items.title: BACKCHECK TO 5 ON 5
items.description: 37 DESCRIPTION • F‘s wait at tops of circles to receive attackers. • F‘s play 3 on 2 below tops of circles - on a goal, whistle or D get puck and pass to F‘s and they attack. • Fbackcheck, D‘s jump in

items.title: BLUE COLLAR
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Race battles • Receptive space + “Surf” to puck carrier DESCRIPTION • Stage 1: X1, X2 race for puck in far end and battle 1vs1 trying to score • Stage 2: O1, O2 race for puck in far end and battle 1vs1 trying to score • Now X1, X2 play “D” vs O1, O2. En- courage X‘s to get up and attack Os. • Stage 3: On whistle, O1, O2 race for puck at the far end, battle and the drill continues 05 | WARM-UPS 38

items.title: BRIERCREST 3 SHOT FLOW
items.description: 39 KEY POINTS: • Multipurpose 3 shot drill • Runs both sides at the same time • Emphasis on hard shots, tight turns, deflec- tions, transitions and puck retrieval DESCRIPTION • F 1, F 2 and D start on whistle • F 2 picks up puck that the coach has dumped, tight turn and attacks net • for shot • F1 and D start, F passes toD who piv- ots and skates backwards with puck, and feeds F who has opened up for pass & accelerates for shot on net, aiming for deflection • Last Part, either F retrieves rebound in corner OR new puck dumped in by coach. • Pass it to D at the point for a third shot • F ‘s combine for a hi-low screen

items.title: BLUE COLLAR
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Timing • Tape-to-tape passing • Drive net hard and shoot DESCRIPTION • Drill starts on both side of the ice simultane- ously • X 1 starts with shot on net, recovers puck from corner. ( O1 does same • on other side) • O 2 times recovery from X 1, X 1 then passes to O 2 • O 3 times pass recovery by skating route, receives pass from O2, then drives net for shot • O 3 recovers puck from corner then times pass to opposite line 05 | WARM-UPS 40

items.title: CHAOS (FULL ICE)
items.description: 41 KEY POINTS: • Keep your head up • Emphasis on stick handling • Progression: Backwards through cones and transition forward up the middle at last cone. DESCRIPTION • Players start in opposite corners. • Each player starts out with a pick and skates up the wall, through the cones in to the neutral zone. • Once through the first four cones, they gain the blue line- hard down and around the bottom cone, then back up the middle of the ice • Go in for a shot on net from the same side of the ice they started

items.title: COMPLETE STATIONS
items.description: DESCRIPTION Zone A: • 4 vs 2 x 2- Cut zone in half. X vs O on each half • D is trying to get pucks to other side of zone • No crossing center ice until whistle is blown to rotate • Works on odd-man O+D, puck movement, one-timers, etc Zone B: • 2 vs 2. 3 “goals”. Score by passing through cones, tape to tape in any direction • Quick transitions, man-to-man coverage, get open to regain positioning Zone C: • 2 vs 1- strong side 2 goals: strong side of puck- dump as two players, weak side has 1 player. Play 2 vs 1 on either goal • Can progress to other configurations and shoot on either goalie • Can have multiple battles going simultaneously 05 | WARM-UPS 42

items.title: CYCLONE
items.description: 43 KEY POINTS: • Hard tape-to-tape passes • Keep head up through middle of the ice • Pass ahead of moving player DESCRIPTION • X1 starts with puck, passes across ice to X3 • X1 skates along blue line, X3 passes back when X1 gets half way across ice • X1 makes touch pass up ice and skates along far blue line and receives a stretch pass from their starting line • X2 repeats on opposite side

items.title: D-INITIATION
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Quick transition, Forwards recognizing they can use D to regroup • Low, hard shot from D at the point • Forward follows shot to net for screen/tip DESCRIPTION • D starts by skating backwards, hard cross- over to gain speed • F passes puck to D who takes puck and pivots around cone • F drives wide to boards, open pivot, showing stick to receive pass back • from D • D passes to F on the fly and immediately jumps into play to play give and go • F ends up with puck and drive inside the dot for a shot on goal • D trails the play, gets pass from . Quickly controls and takes a shot. F follows pass and screens/deflects point shot 05 | WARM-UPS 44

items.title: EHCKK 1
items.description: 45 KEY POINTS: • Quick passes • Keep your feet moving DESCRIPTION • Drill is run from both ends (only one shown) • X1 passes cross ice to X3, X3 passes right back • X1 passes to X2, then pivots and skates hard through the neutral zone • X 2 passes cross ice to second player inX1 line, who then makes a • quick pass to the streaking X1 • Second player joins in rush and goes hard to the far post

items.title: FALCON 2-0/2-1
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Hard crisp passes • F’s take middle • D gets out of the way DESCRIPTION • F1 passes to D1- D1 to D2 • F2 plays center, F1 goes hard to wall • D2 passes to middle or to wall • F’s go in on a 2-0 • D2 follows into zone for a second shot, passed by either F1 or F2 • Opposite F goes net front to set up a screen • PROGRESSION: have D1 take take the 2vs1 05 | WARM-UPS 46

items.title: GO LIVE
items.description: 47 KEY POINTS: • Cycling and going to the net with pick • Back Pressure DESCRIPTION • D1 & D2 start on their knees in circle • 1ST WHISTLE: F’s start to circle around the circle, cycling the puck • 2ND WHISTLE: D get up and D1 engages the F, D2 goes to net • Present F1,2 & 3 make play for scoring, change off cycling • 3RD WHISTLE: the Forwards at blue line with puck and Defence at red line leave going down to the other end. • F1,2 & 3 become back checkers, D join rush and the play becomes a 5 vs 5

items.title: HALF ICE OVERSPEED
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Focus on speed of play as well as breaking out of the zone • Base half ice drill • Play fast, use strong crossovers to increase speed to attack neutral zone, into attacking zone DESCRIPTION • Multiple players breakout to offensive transi- tion. • Beginning base for any of the following 1on0, 2v0, 2v1, 3v1 or 1v1. 05 | WARM-UPS 48

items.title: OVER/UNDER
items.description: 49 KEY POINTS: • Timing • Driving lanes hard • Emphasis on jumping off the wall DESCRIPTION • On whistle, X1 passes to X4, drives to red line and stops • X1 receives pass from X4, jumps off wall, attacking the mid lane for a • shot on net- stops at net • At the same time, X2 skates blueline and pass- es back and forth with X 3. X3 holds puck. • X2 skates to wall and then up red line, cutting across to far dot • X3 receives a stretch pass from the opposite side, X3 and goes in for a shot on net

items.title: QUEBEC 2 VS 1 REGROUP
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Timing- Forwards time shots to allow close support for breakout pass • Quick Transition- with speed for Forwards to be open for regroup pass • Gap Control for Defence in preparation for 2 on 1 DESCRIPTION • D1 initiates drill with shot, followed by F1 and F2 • D1 picks up puck and quickly passes to F breaking out • D2 backpeddles over red line to accept pass from F • D2 passes to either F, regrouping for a 2 vs 1 on D1 05 | WARM-UPS 50

items.title: THREE OPTION REGROUP
items.description: 51 KEY POINTS: • Quick passes with 3 different pass options DESCRIPTION • Three different passing options • Option 1: F1 passes to D1, D1 to D 2 and hit F1 coming through the • middle, go in for a shot on goal • Option 2: F2 passes to D2, D 2 to D1 and hit F2 coming through the • middle, go in for a shot on goal • Option 3: F3 passes to D1, D1 to D 2- F3 tight circle below blue line and • receives a pass on wing, go in for a shot on goal

items.title: WEAVES AND PIVOTS
items.description: KEY POINTS: • Pivots must lead with hip and heels of skates • Stay low through pivots • Cushion passes when receiving to control puck DESCRIPTION PART A: • X does 2 laps around circle, weave in and out of the pylons, receive a pass • from coach in the corner and takes a shot PART B: • X skates forwards to the top of the circle, pivots and then skakes backwards to bottom of the circle. • Pivots at bottom and skates around to the neutral zone • Pivots around pylon in the NZ and then receives a pass from • Stick handle through deviators or rails and go in for a shot 05 | WARM-UPS 52

items.title: Drill 1: Transitions
items.description: Rich Mihelic - Hockey Drills Explanation: Using the whole ice, complete transitions utilizing the lines. There are four versions listed. The line with the squiggle represents backwards skating. V3 and V4 are races.

items.title: Drill 2: Forward vs Backwards race.
items.description: Explanation Line 1 is behind the blue line. Line 2 is at center ice. 2 must start backwards. Players will race to the top of the circles on the opposite end. Once completed, players will hook to the opposite wall and come back to the opposite line.

items.title: Drill 3: Sprints
items.description: Rich Mihelic - Hockey Drills Explanation: On coaches whistle 1 and 2 will start on the edge of the circle. The players must hook and touch the blue line and turn to the near wall for their side. Players will hook around the dot. The drill is a race through the center ice line.

items.title: Drill 4: Passing X - 1 - 2 - 3
items.description: Explanation: X starts with the puck and passes to 1. 1 receives the puck and pivots passing to 2. 2 gets the puck and passes to 3. 3 goes in for a shot on net. Players will follow their pass and go to the next line.

items.title: Drill 5: Passing - Plant Your Feet & Drive
items.teaser: Drill 5: Passing - Plant Your Feet & Drive
items.description: Rich Mihelic - Hockey Drills Explanation: If over 6 players, utilize both sides of the ice as shown. If not, use only one side at a time. This drill moves quickly. 2 will be stationary on the blue line. 1 will pass to 2. 2 will skate backwards to center ice and plant their feet into the ice. Moving the puck with power and on the ice to player 3. 3 will go in and shoot. 2 will move to the 3 spot and 1 will move to spot 2.

items.title: Drill 6: Puck Movement 2-0
items.description: g p p Explanation: On the whistle, 1 will move the puck quickly to 2. 2 will enter the zone and will need to move the puck quickly back to 2. 2 must enter the zone with speed but widen out to create separation in the offensive zone.

items.title: Drill 7: Puck Movement
items.description: Rich Mihelic - Hockey Drills Explanation: 1 will skate below the cones and to the wall. 2 will loop in front of line 1. Coach will pass to player 1. 1 will receive the puck and quickly move it to the middle for player 2. Player 2 will skate in and shoot and move to line 1. Player 1 will move to line 2.

items.title: Drill 8: Puck Movement
items.description: Explanation: On the whistle - utilize one side a time if less than 6 players. 1 will pass to 2. Net or obstacle will be placed where player must pass the puck back quickly behind it and drive for the rebound.

items.title: Drill 9: 2 vs 2
items.description: Rich Mihelic - Hockey Drills Explanation: X vs O’s. On the whistle, players will start as shown. Coach will pass the puck to X player. X’s are trying to score. O is trying to retrieve the puck and pass it to coach. Keeping score.

items.title: Drill 10: 2 vs 2
items.description: Explanation: Place bumper as shown to create separation. 1 will move the puck to 3. 1 and 3 will be on a team and will enter the zone. 2 and 4 are back checking and on defense. 2 and 4 must make a complete pass to coach out of the zone or skate it out. Players are not able to shoot it out!

items.title: Angling 1 vs 1
items.description: X receives a pass from C. X shoots and hooks and receives a pass from coach. O skates to the cone and transitions backwards. X must stay against the wall and O must guide the player to the wall. Finish the 1 vs 1.

items.title: Gap-Up 1 vs 1
items.description: X will complete the skating pattern as shown and shoot. Once the first shot is taken. X will receive a pass from coach. O will skate forward to backwards as shown. O will follow the pattern in the diagram and gap up at the first cone. 1 vs 1. Set 3 cones to set the boundry.

items.title: Drop Pass / Wide Support
items.description: 2 will move the puck to 1. 1 will drop the puck just inside the blue line. 1 will then hook wide as shown. Widening out the ice. 2 will retrieve the drop and move the puck back to 1. 1 will shoot.

items.title: Coach Give-and-Go
items.description: X hooks around the cone and passes to coach. X hooks behind coach and outside the cones. Coach will move the puck back to X.

items.title: Net-Front 2 vs 1
items.description: 2 vs 1 net front. On the whistle 2 vs 1. As the F with the puck hooks out - the other F will angle out to the net for a one time or backdoor pass.

items.title: Area Pass 2 vs 2
items.description: Players gets the puck and dishes it to the other forward (backhand if right hand player on this diagram. Sending an area pass. This play will be a 2 vs 2. 2 forwards vs the Defensive player and back checker. Both sides will go at the same time.

items.title: Backcheck Race - Center Ice
items.description: X has to touch center ice with their stick. O must be on the other side of center ice. Coach will move the puck to X. X will attack the net and O will back check.

items.title: Backcheck from One Knee
items.description: On the whistle, coach will move the puck to X. X must skate along the boards where X can touch the boards with their stick. O starts on one knee and backchecks. Both sides at the time same.

items.title: Faceoff Responsibilities
items.description: Faceoff explanation and responsibility.

items.title: Wide 2 vs 1
items.description: 2 vs 1. F1 will move the puck to F2. F1 MUST widen out. Getting far away from the defensive player finding the open ice. It is crucial that F2 passes the puck quickly while F1 is open. Do not wait to pass the puck as the D can step up and intercept, when the player is there, make the play!

items.title: Backcheck 1 vs 1
items.description: X will start with the puck. O will be inside the center ice circle. 1 vs 1. X starts with the puck and attacks. O backchecks.

items.title: Net Drive / Cutoff 1 vs 1
items.description: X will start behind the blue line and O will start within the ref circle. X will drive to the net and O will try to cut X off crashing to the net.

items.title: Hashmark Shot
items.description: Attack the net and shoot between the hashmarks and dot.

items.title: 3 vs 1 Puck Movement
items.description: 2 starts with the puck and moves the puck to 1. 1 receives and passes it quickly to 3. Defensive player backs up and plays a 3 vs 1.

items.title: Wide Support 2 vs 1
items.description: Player 1 hooks as shown and must receive the pass outside of the cone. 2 hooks thru the middle of the cones as shown. 1 will have a puck and move it to 2. The defensive player will complete the drill as shown. If the defensive player hooks too far to the wall, the player will cut across and move the puck to 1.

items.title: 2 vs 0 Puck Movement
items.description: 2 vs 0 as shown. 1 will start with the puck and move to a cutting across 1.

items.title: Two Shot Passing
items.description: 1 will move the puck to 2. 2 will go in and shoot. 1 will receive a puck from coach and 1 will shoot.

items.title: Coach-to-Coach Passing Flow
items.description: 1 to coach - to other coach - both players hook as shown. 2 will hook around the dot. Coach will move the puck to 2. 2 will move the puck to 1. Drill is then complete unless goalies are available.

items.title: Coach-to-Coach Give-and-Go
items.description: X will pass to coach to coach - X will hook around the cone and receive a puck from coach. Drill is complete unless a goalie is available.

items.title: 3 vs 3 Breakout Transition Game
items.description: 3 vs 3. 12 total players. In this example O’s will be on offense. X must break the puck out to the Red X team. The Red X team will be in the neutral zone moving around and trying to catch the breakout pass from X. Red O must stay in the end zone and play defense. Once a group plays offense they will then switch to defense. Offensive group awaiting the breakout will always be in the neutral zone as where the defensive group will always be in the defensive zone. Defensive players must make a complete pass to the offensive group.

items.title: 2 vs 2 Gap Drill
items.description: 2 vs 2 as shown. Forwards hook around the cones. Coach will move a puck to F group. D will go at the same time maintaining gap and hook around the dot. 2 vs 2.

items.title: D-to-F 1 vs 1
items.description: D will skate up and pass to coach. Forward will hook as shown. Coach will move the puck to the forward. Players will compete on a 1 vs 1.

items.title: Two-Player Passing Flow
items.description: 1 will pass to coach. 1 and 2 will hook as shown. Coach will move the puck to 2. 2 will move the puck back to 1.
